AI.conclusion: 论文提出核心结论：当生成式AI进入创作流程时，研究与实践的焦点应从"AI是有助于还是损害创造力"转向"**哪种混合配置**能让个体的创新收益累积而不侵蚀集体多样性"。创造力应当被理解为**混合集群体**的属性，由人与算法的互动结构塑造，而非单纯属于任何一方。

title: Loom: Weaving Diagnostic Strands into Free-Text Consensus via Embedding-Space Reweighting
summary: Aggregating noisy, conflicting textual hypotheses into a reliable consensus is a fundamental challenge when deploying NLP systems in real-world industrial settings. While monolithic Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer unbounded expressivity for tasks like Root Cause Analysis (RCA), they suffer from context limits, compounding hallucinations, and prohibitive inference latency. Traditional weak supervision offers statistical rigor but is mathematically restricted to discrete classes. We present Loom, a generative consensus framework deployed for real-world RCA that bridges these paradigms. Loom aggregates open-form hypotheses emitted by modular heuristics (diagnostic templates dynamically populated with episode-specific entities, times, and metrics) by projecting them into a continuous embedding space, and resolves conflicting signals with an iterative centroid-based reweighting algorithm. The resulting consensus weights ground a single lightweight LLM synthesis step. Evaluated on the OpenRCA benchmark, Loom occupies the accuracy--efficiency Pareto frontier: it matches a state-of-the-art autonomous agent on Bank and Market-2 and trails on Market-1 and Telecom, while using a single LLM call per incident on all four datasets ($\sim$26$\times$ faster; $\sim$33$\times$ with an 8B-parameter synthesizer). We discuss our deployment experience, highlighting lessons learned regarding the trade-offs between agentic depth and inference latency, negative results in redundancy detection, and how deterministic consensus fosters trust among Subject Matter Experts~(SMEs).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Loom 框架,通过将模块化启发式(诊断链/DS)生成的开放性文本假设投影到连续嵌入空间,利用基于质心的迭代重加权算法解决冲突信号,最后由轻量级 LLM 综合生成单一根因分析结论。
AI.motivation: 工业级 NLP 部署中,如何聚合噪声大且互相冲突的文本假设是一大挑战。单体 LLM Agent 灵活但受限于上下文窗口、复合幻觉及高延迟;传统弱监督统计严谨但仅适用于离散类别,无法处理自由文本。本文旨在桥接两类范式。
AI.method: 1) 诊断链(DS):由专家或 LLM 离线提取的程序化启发式,动态填充遥测数据生成模板化假设;2) 迭代嵌入-质心重加权:将输出嵌入连续向量空间,根据与加权质心的余弦相似度迭代更新权重,结合静态冗余分组;3) LLM 综合:基于权重排序的证据,由单一轻量 LLM 调用合成最终根因分析报告。
AI.result: 在 OpenRCA 基准四个数据集上,Loom 在 Bank 和 Market-2 上与 SOTA 自主代理持平,Market-1 与 Telecom 上略逊,但每次事故仅需 1 次 LLM 调用(~22 秒),相比 Agent(~567 秒、~62 次调用)实现 ~26× 加速,使用 8B 模型可达 ~33× 加速。消融显示重加权贡献 +5.88 pp 严格精度,但静态冗余检测出现负结果。
AI.conclusion: Loom 在精度-效率 Pareto 前沿上具有竞争力,通过确定性、可审计的流水线促进信任,可支持小型本地化模型部署,适合工业场景的严格延迟与成本约束;但单次综合在高度复杂数据集上存在局限,建议混合策略(Loom 候选 + 轻量 Agent 消歧)以弥合差距。

title: Door-in-the-Face Requests and Refusal Behaviour in Large Language Models
comment: 28 pages (9 pages of content plus references and appendix), 5 figures, 9 tables. Preprint, under review
summary: Does the door-in-the-face technique work on language models? In humans, a large request that is refused makes a smaller follow-up request more likely to be granted. We test this on nine production models from three providers: each model refuses a large request, then receives a smaller version of the same request, and we compare its compliance with asking directly. The answer depends on the model. On Anthropic's frontier models the technique works: Opus 5 answers the smaller request 65.8% of the time after refusing the larger one, against 29.3% when asked directly. On the frontier models of OpenAI and Google, and on Haiku 4.5, it backfires, lowering compliance by 15.5 to 23.0 points. A control locates the effect: a refused large request on an unrelated topic does less than the related one on all nine models, so the concession itself matters everywhere, while the reaction to having just refused something differs by model family. The technique does not transfer to refusals drawn from public benchmarks. What decides whether a retreat can work is what the request asks for: rewriting 265 refused requests for usable instructions into requests for explanations of the same topic removed the refusal in 263 cases. Human influence techniques port to language models one model family at a time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究社会心理学中的"以退为进"（door-in-the-face, DITF）请求技巧是否适用于大型语言模型。在9个商用大模型（来自Anthropic、OpenAI、Google）上测试发现：先请求一个会被拒的大问题、再请求同一主题的小问题，相比直接请求小问题，结果因模型家族而异——Anthropic前沿模型上该技巧显著有效（如Opus 5从29.3%升至65.8%），但在OpenAI/Google前沿模型及Haiku 4.5上反而降低合规率15.5-23.0个百分点。研究还发现，小请求要求的内容类型（判断型vs.可操作型）是决定退让能否成功的关键。
AI.motivation: 人类社会中广泛使用的DITF社会影响技巧能否迁移到大语言模型？此前的研究要么将DITF作为单轮改述而没有真实拒绝，要么只关注拒绝作为安全障碍，缺乏对"真实拒绝-撤退到较小请求"这一完整多轮序列的系统检验。同时，了解哪些人类心理规律能跨模型迁移，对于模型安全性和社交模拟应用都至关重要。
AI.method: 采用受控的多臂实验设计（4种条件：直接请求cold、DITF、先良性热身warm-up、不相关拒绝），使用60个"判断型"测试项（要求对真实机构做出负面评价）和399个从公共基准抽取的"可操作型"项。测试9个商用模型（Anthropic: Opus 5/4.8/4.5、Sonnet 5、Haiku 4.5；OpenAI: GPT-5.6 sol、GPT-5 mini；Google: Gemini 3.1 Pro、3 Flash），由跨家族的裁判模型双盲评分合规性。用项目聚类bootstrap计算置信区间，精确符号翻转检验加Holm校正。
AI.result: 1) **模型家族间效应反转**：Anthropic前沿模型DITF效应为+13.7至+36.5 pp（Opus 5从29.3%升至65.8%）；Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.6 sol、Gemini 3.1 Pro上DITF反降15.5-23.0 pp；GPT-5 mini、Gemini 3 Flash效应不显著。2) **收敛溢价普遍存在**：在所有9个模型上，自身被拒的锚请求比不相关被拒请求效果好0.7-22.8 pp。3) **DITF不迁移到基准请求**：在公共基准抽取的"可操作型"项（要指令/代码等）上无模型显著获益，Opus 5反而下降13.3 pp。4) **交付物类型决定退让有效性**：将265个被拒的可操作请求改写为关于同一主题的解释型请求后，263个总是合规。判断型请求是DITF获益的必要条件，模型家族决定其余部分。
AI.conclusion: 不存在模型通用的DITF效应，但存在模型通用的"收敛溢价"。人类影响技巧向大语言模型的迁移是按模型家族逐个实现的——同一撤退序列在Opus 5上提升36.5 pp，在Gemini 3.1 Pro上降低23.0 pp。变化的是模型对"前序被拒"的家族特异性反应，而非收敛本身的价值。退让能否起效取决于小请求要求的内容类型（判断型 vs. 可操作型）。结果对社交模拟和AI安全有直接启示：模拟效应方向取决于具体模型版本，必须逐模型、逐版本建立有效性；DITF并非越狱方向，基准上的效应均为负向，真正暴露的表面是"可操作型"请求。

title: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
summary: Autonomous agents are beginning to carry out machine-learning (ML) research end to end. These agents combine a model backbone with a harness for planning, execution, memory, and verification, but this architecture still leaves domain-specific know-how outside the agent. We call this missing layer operational knowledge, the know-how that separates knowing a method from making it work. That knowledge is not absent from the field. It appears in repositories and papers, but in forms written for human readers and too large to load during a task. Once distilled into compact, verified skills, this knowledge can be reused across tasks rather than rediscovered during each run. We present DisCo, a skill-powered research agent that creates skills and uses them during research. Its distillation runs in two complementary forms: task-agnostic, condensing the field's widely used repositories into reusable skills, and task-oriented, producing the skills a concrete task calls for. The former, applied across the open ecosystem, yields the AREX-Skill Library, with 5,000+ verified skills distilled from 1,000 widely used ML repositories and organized into 20 areas and 178 capability families. With the GPT-5.5 backbone, research harness, and downstream execution budget held fixed, the skill-equipped research agent scores 134.3% higher on MLE-bench, 34.4% higher on PaperBench, 9.2% higher on FrontierCS, and 14.0% higher on PassNet than the same agent without skills. These gains come from adding distilled operating context under that fixed setup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DisCo 框架与 AREX-Skill 库，通过从 GitHub 仓库中蒸馏出可复用的"操作知识技能图"，在不改变模型与执行框架的前提下，使自主研究代理在多个 ML 基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 当前自主研究代理由"模型"和"执行框架(harness)"两部分组成，但缺乏领域专用的"操作知识"(operational knowledge)，即"知道一个方法"与"让方法真正可用"之间的差距。这些知识分散在仓库和论文中，规模过大且为人编写，难以直接被代理在任务中加载使用。
AI.method: 1. 提出三层技能表示(SKILL.md / references/ / scripts/)，以技能图(skill graph)形式组织，通过"渐进式披露"控制上下文开销。2. 设计四阶段技能蒸馏流水线(scope → ground → construct → verify)，包含任务无关蒸馏(从仓库/论文提炼)和任务导向蒸馏(根据具体任务生成技能)。3. 构建 AREX-Skill 库，覆盖 1,000 个 ML 仓库，产出 5,000+ 已验证技能，按 20 个领域和 178 个能力族进行索引，并通过路由器检索。4. 每个技能在加入前都需经过断言式可用性检查与本地修复循环。
AI.result: 在固定 GPT-5.5 backbone 与 Codex harness、匹配运行预算的条件下：MLE-bench(75 项)Any Medal 从 31.11% 提升至 72.89%(+134.3%)；PaperBench(20 篇)平均复现分从 29.45 提升至 39.59(+34.4%)；FrontierCS(188 项)Score 从 70.63 提升至 77.14(+9.22%)；PassNet(200 样本)AS Score 从 1.343 提升至 1.531(+14.0%)，失败样本从 14 降至 5。在多个基准上反超 Gemini-3-Pro、Claude-Opus 等更强基座。收益在困难任务和低分基线任务上尤其显著。
AI.conclusion: 为自主研究代理引入外部化的、可验证的、可复用的操作知识层，能够在不改动模型或执行框架的情况下持续提升其表现；并证明"技能"是承载此类知识的有效、可移植的载体，未来可与任何兼容 harness 结合。

title: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems commonly use an orchestrator to decompose a task for a team of workers and then improve through textual reflection. Despite strong empirical results, these systems lack a unified account of coordination, memory improvement, and the role of external verification. We model orchestrator-worker interaction as a bilevel coordination game: under bounded coupling, the workers' local-update game is an approximate potential game whose equilibrium slack is controlled by decomposition quality. We then analyse reflection as stochastic movement over semantic memory states. For free-form reflection, we derive a finite-time upper bound, prove worst-case tightness, and give a positive lower bound under a falsifiable persistent-harm condition. We further prove an information-theoretic impossibility result: no gate that observes only the generated transcript can improve uniformly over text-indistinguishable environments, whereas an environment-grounded gate can. Motivated by this separation, we introduce Stochastic Reflective Memory Ascent (SRMA), which accepts a candidate memory only after a grounded evaluation risk strictly decreases. Under calibration and non-degenerate corrective mass, SRMA converges exactly, geometrically or polynomially; matching constructions show that both rate regimes are order-tight. We also provide confidence gating for stochastic evaluation and re-anchoring guarantees for piecewise-stationary environments. Experiments instantiate these objects with environment-grounded metrics and test the predicted coordination and drift laws. On 500 SWE-bench instances, the complete Kimi-based system resolves 72.2% versus a 70.8% public mini-SWE-agent reference. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出"双层协调反思"(Bilevel Coordinated Reflection)框架，将多智能体LLM系统中的协调者-工作者交互建模为双层协调博弈，将文本反思建模为语义记忆状态上的随机过程，并提出基于环境验证器的随机反思记忆上升(SRMA)算法，证明了精确收敛及阶最优的收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统（如AutoGen、MetaGPT）虽经验性能强，但缺乏统一的理论框架来解释：(1)协调者任务分解质量如何控制工作者协调；(2)无门控反思何时会停滞；(3)为何外部验证器比纯文本评判更有效。
AI.method: 方法包含四部分：(1)将协调者-工作者建模为弱耦合分解下的双层协调博弈，证明工作者子博弈为近似势能博弈，松弛量η_c ≤ 2d_max·κ；(2)分析自由形式反思的双侧漂移，给出有限时间上界与最紧下界；(3)证明信息论不可能定理：仅观察生成文本的门控无法在文本不可区分环境中一致改进；(4)提出SRMA算法——仅在评估风险严格下降时接受新记忆，证明在几何(β=0)与多项式(β>0)速率下收敛，且速率阶最优。
AI.result: 在Resource Contest上SRMA达到oracle奖励的98.5%–99.5%；Overcooked三个布局上SRMA均优于自门控14.3%–30%；门控质量消融显示有门控SRMA有害提议接受率仅6.2%（自门控34.5%）；SWE-bench 500实例上基于Kimi K2.5的完整系统解析率72.2%，超过公开mini-SWE-agent v2参考70.8%；漂移参数β̂=0.52±0.04，预测风险轨迹与留出数据Pearson相关系数r=0.94。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多智能体LLM系统提供了协调、反思与验证三者统一的理论框架。核心结论是：仅靠反思不足以收敛；必须依赖环境接地的验证器门控；SRMA提供了阶最优的精确收敛保证。局限性包括保证条件性、验证器-任务不完全校准、以及与基线比较非完全受控等问题。

title: Measurement-Driven Sub-Network Selection for On-Premise Retrieval-Augmented Factory Agents
summary: On-premise assistants can give factory workers conversational access to machine documentation, but models capable of the task rarely fit shop-floor hardware. We show that after structural compression and retrieval-grounded adaptation, model size is no longer a reliable predictor of adapted answer quality: general capability falls almost linearly with parameter count, while judged retrieval-augmented answer quality does not. We therefore treat deployment as a post-adaptation selection problem, committing one sub-network per device on judged answer quality and measured on-device throughput under a configurable general-capability floor and memory budget; rules that optimize size, speed, or quality alone each give up capability or throughput. A weight-shared supernetwork trained with sandwich-style in-place distillation keeps this selection inexpensive. In a manufacturing-manual case study, extraction costs 13.7 percent of the unpruned model's judged quality and retrieval-grounded distillation returns it to within 4.6 percent, recovering two thirds of the loss, and the same assistant runs across three heterogeneous edge tiers at 1.3 to 5 watts standby.

AI.tldr: 针对工厂车间边缘硬件（2-8GB内存）部署RAG助手的难题，本文提出"训练一次、按设备选取子网络"的多阶段流水线：权重共享超网络+三明治式原地蒸馏→11候选网格→RAG场景适配→基于实测质量的硬件感知选择。结果显示压缩后模型大小不再可靠预测适配质量；选择需在通用能力底线（ARC-Easy）与内存预算下，按实测RAG质量与吞吐联合优化。在工厂手册案例中，提取损失13.7%质量，检索蒸馏恢复至仅差4.6%（恢复2/3损失）；同一系统可在3档异构边缘硬件上运行，待机功耗1.3-5瓦。
AI.motivation: 工厂车间文档查询需要本地LLM助手，但能满足技术问答的模型通常数十亿参数，无法装入2-8GB边缘硬件；云端方案引入延迟、成本与数据主权问题；每部署训练小模型不经济；仅结构化剪枝又会损害通用能力。核心发现：压缩并适配后，参数规模与适配质量不再强相关，因此部署时机选择（而非训练时选择）成为关键。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 权重共享超网络用三明治式原地蒸馏训练（每步：全网络CE损失 + M=3采样子网络CE损失 + KL对齐）；11点校准网格按WikiText困惑度选bin内最佳。(2) 每个候选用LoRA(r=8)在工厂手册RAG数据上做检索感知蒸馏（RAFT含50%干扰块）；Loss=α'CE+β'τ'²KL(p_T||p_S)，τ'=2。(3) 硬件感知选择：实测每个候选的RAG质量、吞吐、延迟、内存、能耗，按Eq.(2)在ARC-Easy能力底线ϕ=0.8与内存上限下，取Pareto前沿上Q/T加权最优点；吞吐由3锚点预测器（tok/s=a/n_params）拟合。导出W8A16 ONNX或Q4_K_M GGUF。
AI.result: Llama-3.2-3B/1B超网络：(a) 提取使判断RAG质量降13.7%，检索蒸馏后仅差未剪枝基线4.6%（恢复2/3损失，n=633，bootstrap95%CI[-5.9%,-3.3%]）；(b) ARC-Easy近线性下降(R²=0.93)，判断RAG质量仅弱序(R²=0.76)，rank6与最大候选相当；(c) Stage-2消融：无适配0.701、纯SFT降至0.654、任务损失0.727、+KD 0.760、+RAFT 0.765；(d) 3B rank6选自Jetson/RevPi，1B rank5选自UNO Q；硬件：Jetson 9.95 TPS/0.23s TTFT/5.9GB/117J/4.96W待机；RevPi 4.00 TPS/2.3GB/170J/2.48W；UNO Q 4.53 TPS/0.63GB/149J/1.30W；质量0.773/0.845/0.811（3B）与0.591/0.749/0.682（1B）；(e) 简化规则（最小/最快/最大可行/仅质量/无底线混合）都会牺牲能力或吞吐；(f) 路由40/40正确；(g) 新设备仅需3锚点基准（约6h而非28.8h）。
AI.conclusion: 应用适配打破"尺寸-质量"排序，故部署选择必须在适配之后、在通用能力底线与内存约束下基于实测RAG质量与吞吐联合进行；仅优化尺寸、速度或质量的规则都更差。权重共享超网络使该选择廉价。所提流水线在工厂手册案例中恢复约95%未剪枝质量，在2GB Arduino到Jetson Orin Nano三档异构边缘上运行同一助手；新设备仅需3个锚点基准。未来工作将选择扩展到校准网格之外，并加入全智能体环路的端到端实测。

title: SafeEvolve: Harness-Policy Co-Evolution from Agent Experience for Safety Alignment
summary: The performance of LLM-based agents is jointly shaped by the base model and the harness used when interacting with the environment. This exposes them to safety risks in both harmful final responses and multi-step execution trajectories. Existing safety alignment mechanisms often rely on either external harness updates or policy optimization, yet applying either paradigm in isolation fails to bridge runtime control with intrinsic safety. We propose SafeEvolve, an experience-driven self-evolving framework for agent safety alignment. SafeEvolve leverages safety experience from completed on-policy trajectories to drive a continual loop of harness-policy co-evolution. On the harness side, SafeEvolve converts trajectory-level safety evidence into bounded, component-level updates across safety prompt and hierarchical skills, yielding auditable and reversible harness artifacts. On the policy side, SafeEvolve follows a two-stage SFT-RL paradigm, where harness-use SFT bootstraps the policy to actively leverage evolved harness artifacts, and harness-augmented RL further shapes autonomous safety behaviors during multi-step exploration via verifier-decomposed rewards. Through harness-policy co-evolution, SafeEvolve converts safety experience into an evolved runtime harness and improved policy behavior. Experiments on agentic safety benchmarks show that SafeEvolve achieves a stronger safety-utility tradeoff than existing baselines. For Qwen3.5-4B, SafeEvolve achieves a $3\times$ ASR reduction on AgentDojo while improving benign utility from 59.79% to 61.86%.

AI.tldr: SafeEvolve提出了一种基于经验驱动的LLM智能体安全对齐框架，通过harness（提示与技能库）与policy的协同进化循环，将多步轨迹中的安全证据转化为可审计的harness更新和策略行为改进，在AgentDojo、AgentDyn、AgentHarm等基准上实现更好的安全-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体安全对齐方法分为两类：仅依赖外部harness（提示/技能/护栏）或仅优化policy参数。前者在policy能力不足时执行不可靠、与动作脱节；后者在固定harness下训练，无法适应新出现的失败模式。两者均无法同时桥接运行时控制与内在安全，亟需将harness refinement与policy update紧耦合的协同进化机制。
AI.method: SafeEvolve框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 可观测驱动的harness进化——将轨迹级安全证据转化为对safety prompt和分层技能库（通用/任务特定/常见错误）的有界、版本化、可回滚的组件级更新，通过配对accept-reject机制验证；(2) Harness增强的policy优化——采用两阶段SFT-RL范式：harness-use SFT冷启动使policy学会使用进化的harness工件；harness增强的RL（基于GRPO+KL）通过验证器分解的安全-效用奖励（按clean/query/injection三类任务定制）将harness指导内化为多步执行中的自主安全行为。两者通过持续循环形成飞轮效应。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507两个backbone上，SafeEvolve在AgentDojo、AgentDyn（间接提示注入）和AgentHarm（恶意查询）三个基准上均取得最优安全-效用权衡。Qwen3.5-4B上AgentDojo ASR从2.37%降至0.79%（3×降低），良性效用从59.79%升至61.86%；AgentHarm有害分从56.45降至12.27，拒绝率从28.98%升至83.83%。消融实验表明：(1)仅harness进化（冻结policy）即可显著提升安全；(2)协同进化优于纯harness或纯policy进化；(3)分层技能库检索与动态优先级是关键；(4)进化harness可跨policy迁移但增益依赖目标模型能力；(5)在ASB held-out基准上也展现强泛化性。
AI.conclusion: SafeEvolve通过harness-policy协同进化将完成的多步轨迹转化为持续的安全自我改进，harness进化提供可审计、可回滚的安全工件，policy优化通过两阶段SFT-RL将其内化为内在安全行为。实验证明该框架在多类agent安全风险（环境注入、恶意查询、PoT后门等）上实现更强的安全-效用权衡，且具有较好的跨模型和跨攻击泛化能力。未来工作可探索多时间尺度的元进化框架以及开放任务下的安全受控进化机制。

title: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Telecom Root Cause Analysis (RCA): A Structured Reasoning Framework for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical task in telecom network operations, but diagnosing performance degradations in modern 5G and emerging 6G networks remains challenging due to complex cross-layer dependencies. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising capabilities for reasoning and knowledge integration, directly applying vanilla LLMs to telecom RCA often leads to hallucination, unstable reasoning, and poor alignment with structured network evidence. This work first reviews the evolution of telecom RCA from rule-based and machine learning (ML) approaches to emerging LLM-enabled techniques, and provides an overview of recent paradigms, including structured reasoning, retrieval-augmented knowledge grounding, agentic orchestration, and verifiable reasoning. Building upon these insights, we propose a structured reasoning framework for LLM-enabled telecom RCA that aligns diagnostic reasoning with telecom-specific evidence and domain knowledge. The proposed approach first organizes heterogeneous network telemetry into canonical contexts, and then enforces decision-path reasoning during diagnosis, and finally generates evidence-grounded explanations for reliable fault identification. Experimental results on two 5G RCA datasets, TeleLogs and TelecomTS, demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves diagnostic accuracy and decision consistency compared with baseline techniques. These cross-dataset results highlight the importance of structured reasoning design for practical LLM-based RCA systems in next-generation telecom networks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对5G/6G电信网络中的根因分析（RCA）任务，提出了一种名为SEKA-FT的结构化推理微调框架。该框架通过规范上下文结构、思维链决策路径控制以及证据与知识锚定的解释设计，将异构网络遥测数据组织为标准化的证据块，并强制模型在做出最终RCA决策前执行阶段性诊断检查，从而生成可溯源至具体网络KPI的故障解释。在TeleLogs和TelecomTS两个5G RCA数据集上的实验表明，SEKA-FT显著优于ICL、LSTM和普通SFT基线，证明了结构化推理设计对于可靠LLM-RCA系统的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现代5G/6G电信网络因跨层耦合关系复杂，使性能劣化根因定位极为困难。虽然LLM具备强大的推理和知识整合能力，但直接应用于电信RCA存在三大核心问题：推理路径不稳定、异构结构化证据对齐不足以及幻觉倾向。这些缺陷导致模型可能基于表面相关性而非因果关系做出错误诊断。此外，传统基于规则的方法难以扩展，基于ML的方法则退化为统计模式识别，缺乏显式诊断推理能力，难以泛化至未见过的新故障模式。因此亟需一种将LLM推理能力与电信领域结构化证据深度对齐的方法。
AI.method: 本文提出SEKA-FT（Structured Evidence- and Knowledge-Aligned Fine-Tuning）框架，由三大耦合组件构成：（1）规范上下文结构化（Canonical Context Structuring），将异构网络遥测数据重组为瓶颈快照、UE全局状态、轨迹级事件、工程参数等一致的语义块，降低输入噪声并稳定特征空间；（2）CoT启用的决策路径控制（CoT-enabled Decision-Path Control），将RCA重构为多阶段诊断检查（如UE速度、调度RB数、切换次数、覆盖距离），在最终决策前逐步剪枝不可靠假设；（3）证据与知识锚定的解释设计（Evidence- and Knowledge-Anchored Explanation），引入两步式解释监督——Step 1基于结构化输入生成可解释检查结论，Step 2根据检查结果和领域知识进行假设精炼。微调过程采用token级因果语言建模损失（掩码prompt），以Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct为主基模型，并应用LoRA对最后四个Transformer块进行参数高效微调。
AI.result: 在TeleLogs数据集上，SEKA-FT以Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct为基模型达到了0.942±0.006的Accuracy和0.937±0.007的Macro-F1，远超Vanilla SFT（0.007）、SFT+Explanation（0.030）、SFT+Structured Input（0.256）和LSTM（0.132）等基线方法。在跨数据集验证的TelecomTS上，SEKA-FT取得了0.647±0.004的Accuracy和0.615±0.005的Macro-F1，同样显著优于所有对比方法。统计检验（McNemar和paired permutation test，p<0.001）确认其与最强基线（SFT+Structured Input）之间的差异具有高度显著性。此外，SEKA-FT在所有评估的诊断检查中均表现出近乎完美的决策路径一致性，并且收敛速度更快、稳定性更强；其ICL基线即使扩展到Qwen3-32B仍仅取得0.126的Accuracy，凸显了结构化推理设计相较单纯扩大模型规模的优越性。决策空间分析显示，连续诊断检查可使平均候选集大小从8逐步降至2.5，有效降低了最终决策难度。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了将RCA从纯标签预测重构为证据-路径-决策的结构化推理监督，能够显著提升LLM在电信根因分析中的诊断准确性与推理稳定性。SEKA-FT框架通过联合对齐结构化证据、中间诊断路径、最终RCA标签和可溯源解释，有效缓解了LLM的幻觉问题，增强了推理一致性，并在两个差异化的5G RCA基准上表现出跨数据集的鲁棒性。这一结果证实了结构化推理设计对于下一代网络中实用化LLM-RCA系统的关键价值。未来工作将把该框架扩展至核心网、传输网故障以及真实运营商事件等更广泛的电信RCA场景。

title: AI Contextual Measurement for Recovering Individual and Group-Level Effects: Validation Against Survey Measures and an Occupational Application
summary: Researchers increasingly use artificial intelligence to construct measures of social, organizational, and occupational characteristics that are absent from conventional surveys. We propose AICOME, AI COntextual MEasurement, a framework for evaluating whether AI-derived respondent-level measures can recover individual and group-level effects in contextual models. The key idea is that an AI measure constructed at the respondent level can be used to derive its group-level aggregate and its individual deviation, allowing researchers to estimate both between-group and within-group associations rather than treating AI measurement as response prediction alone. We validate the framework using the 2022 China Family Panel Studies (CFPS), where occupations provide the empirical grouping structure and several job-related survey variables provide validation benchmarks. For computer use, foreign-language use, weekly hours, and management responsibilities, we compare survey measures with AI-derived measures in response-level, model-level, contextual, and boundary-condition validations. The results show that AI contextual measurement can recover much of the contextual-model information contained in observed survey variables when rich respondent and job characteristics are available. Weekly hours provides the strongest validation case, with AI-derived measures reproducing the large negative between- and within-occupation associations with satisfaction observed in CFPS. The framework also identifies clear boundary conditions: performance deteriorates when information is restricted to occupation and basic demographics, and recovery is weaker when several related concepts are treated as simultaneously unobserved. The findings suggest that AICOME is most useful for recovering a limited number of theoretically important constructs from rich existing datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AICOME框架，将AI衍生的个体层面度量分解为组均值与个体偏离，用于恢复多层级背景模型中的组间与组内效应。基于2022年中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS），验证了AI测度在恢复组间和组内效应方面的有效性，并应用于不可直接观测的潜在职业特征分析。
AI.motivation: 社会科学的许多研究问题涉及组间与组内同时变化的变量（如工人嵌套于职业、学生嵌套于学校）。现有AI测量方法（如O*NET、大语言模型对职业打分）多为组层面分数，无法识别组内异质性。同时已有AI辅助调查预测工作主要关注响应恢复，而非推断任务的有效性。因此需要一种框架，将个体层面的AI测度用于背景（contextual）分析，恢复组间和组内两层次的因果效应。
AI.method: 核心方法是将个体层面的AI度量 Z_i 分解为组均值 Z̄_{g(i)} 与个体偏离 (Z_i - Z̄_{g(i)})，使其在背景模型中可同时估计个体效应 β_I、组间效应 β_G 和情景效应 β_C。验证框架包含四个层次：响应层级一致性、模型层级（R² 与拟合值）、情景结构（组间/组内系数方向与大小）、以及边界条件分析（信息丰富度与同时缺失情境）。实证使用2022年CFPS数据，以职业为分组单位、工作满意度为结果变量，对四个可观测维度（电脑使用、外语使用、周工时、管理职责）进行AI1（单维缺失）与AI4（同时缺失）两种信息设定下的验证，并通过"丰富提示"与"调查提示"两种提示策略评估稳健性。进一步将经过诊断修正的框架应用于四个潜在职业维度（自主性、人/物取向、创意/常规、技术强度）。
AI.result: 单维验证中，电脑使用、外语使用、周工时和管理职责的AI测度与CFPS观察值高度相关（0.684–0.986），其中管理职责最强。周工时验证效果最佳：AI测度恢复了CFPS中观察到的工作满意度的大幅负向组间（β_G ≈ -0.247）与组内（β_I ≈ -0.135）效应。边界条件检验发现：当仅提供职业与基本人口学信息时，AI表现急剧下降（如周工时相关性从0.9降至接近零）；当四个相关变量同时缺失时，整体R²增量由0.0269降至0.0142–0.0167，较弱效应变得不稳定。潜在维度应用中，人/物取向呈现出最稳健的正向组效应，修复后的自主性测度（在剔除"时间灵活性"混淆变量后）呈现稳定的正向个体效应。
AI.conclusion: AICOME框架表明，个体层面的AI测度能在丰富受访者与职业信息可用时有效恢复背景模型中组间与组内推断，但该方法有明确边界条件：信息稀疏时表现急剧恶化，多个相关概念同时缺失时恢复能力减弱。AI不应被视为调查测量的替代品，而最适合用于从已有丰富数据中恢复有限数量的重要理论构念。潜在维度应用进一步展示了对AI测度进行诊断与修正的必要性——AI可能因对输入特征赋予不当权重而产生系统性偏差，需要研究者结合实质性判断进行人工校正。

title: Discriminative World Models for Web Agents
summary: Recent web agents use world models for test-time action selection by sampling candidate actions, predicting the resulting web states, and ranking them with a ranker model or a Process Reward Model (PRM). These world models are typically trained via supervised next-state prediction to generate fixed representations like HTML or AXTree snapshots. However, this objective is misaligned with the downstream ranker, which relies on predicted states being discriminative across candidates to accurately score them. To address this, we introduce predicted-state matching, a training objective where the predicted representation must distinguish the true resulting state from those reached by alternative actions. We train these models using a branching web-agent dataset derived from WebArena Go-Browse trajectories, where every decision point contains multiple alternative actions and their resulting states. Experiments on our held-out predicted-state matching benchmark show that our approach outperforms world models trained with supervised next-state prediction. We further show that our approach improves PRM-style action ranking on WebPRMBench compared with action-only PRMs and PRMs augmented with supervised-next-state world models. Finally, on WebArena-Lite, using our world model for test-time action selection improves end-to-end task success. Our project page is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出"预测状态匹配"(predicted-state matching)训练目标，替代传统的监督式下一状态预测，用于训练Web智能体的判别式世界模型。该方法通过匹配任务（让生成表示区分真实结果状态与同一决策点其他动作导致的替代状态）训练模型，并构建了基于Go-Browse轨迹的分支式Web智能体数据集。在保留测试集、WebPRMBench动作排序以及WebArena-Lite端到端任务上均优于监督式下一状态预测的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体的世界模型采用监督式下一状态预测训练（生成HTML/AXTree等固定格式），其训练目标与下游排序器/PRM所需的判别能力不匹配——固定格式的预测可能忽视动作相关的差异信息。
AI.method: 提出预测状态匹配目标：给定当前状态和查询动作，模型生成下一状态的文本表示，由固定裁判(Qwen3-32B)在不接触指令/历史/当前状态的情况下，判断该表示能否从同一决策点的替代状态中识别出真实结果状态。使用GRPO优化(R=R_match+λ_fmt·R_fmt)。构建分支数据集：将Go-Browse的线性轨迹中重复出现的浏览器状态合并为状态-动作图，形成具有多个候选动作及对应结果状态的分支决策点(7,730个决策点，30,920个成对样本)。
AI.result: 在保留测试集上，预测状态匹配准确率达到80.80%，优于WebDreamer-7B (74.51%)、WebWorld-8B (70.17%)和数据匹配的监督式基线 (47.77%)。在三个裁判模型(Qwen3-32B/GPT-4o/Llama-3.1-70B)上均保持优势。在WebPRMBench上，结合受控Qwen2.5-7B奖励模型，平均Best-of-N准确率达72.70%，优于无状态基线(55.80%)和WebWorld-8B增强(67.63%)。在WebArena-Lite端到端任务中，使用世界模型进行Best-of-5动作选择将GPT-4o任务成功率从ReAct的13.94%提升至28.48%。此外，预测平均仅91.6 tokens，远短于WebWorld-8B的412.7 tokens。
AI.conclusion: Web世界模型应保留动作相关的判别性差异，而非仅复现预定义的下一状态格式。预测状态匹配作为表示无关的目标，能够训练出更短、更具判别力的下一状态表示，并能有效提升下游PRM动作排序和端到端Web智能体任务表现。

title: WMLLM: Self-Evolving Optimization Agents via Predict-Then-Act World Modeling
summary: Black-box optimization problems remain challenging because of large, weakly structured, and high-dimensional search spaces. Existing methods often suffer from poor sample efficiency because they rely on direct candidate generation or trial-and-error refinement. A natural way to improve search efficiency is to use world modeling, which can help identify promising optimization directions before costly evaluation. Large language models can predict the outcomes of these candidates with nontrivial accuracy because of their implicit knowledge. Motivated by this observation, we propose WMLLM, a self-evolving optimization-agent framework based on predict-then-act world modeling. The agent first predicts promising directions and then acts to generate candidates. Combined with agentic multi-turn refinement, population-based search, and reinforcement learning, WMLLM refines both its implicit world model and its optimization strategy during search. Experiments on black-box optimization tasks, especially multi-objective molecular optimization, show that WMLLM improves sample efficiency and final optimization performance. On the multi-objective molecular optimization benchmark, WMLLM achieves state-of-the-art results under a limited evaluation budget.

AI.tldr: WMLLM提出了一种基于"预测-执行"世界建模的自演化优化智能体框架，通过要求LLM在生成候选解前显式预测其评估结果，利用预测-观测差异作为自监督信号，结合智能体多轮交互、基于种群的搜索和GRPO训练，在黑盒优化任务（尤其多目标分子优化）上实现样本效率和最终性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有黑盒优化方法依赖直接候选生成或试错式精炼，在高维、结构弱、评估昂贵的搜索空间中样本效率低下。LLM虽具备隐式世界知识但未被作为主动预测组件用于决策优化，且传统世界模型需独立模块，难以在高维离散空间中扩展。
AI.method: 1）问题形式化：在结构化离散搜索空间上进行黑盒多目标优化，评估器不可微；2）基于种群的进化搜索：维护50个候选的种群，一半按标量分数、一半按Pareto排名选择；3）智能体多轮生成：LLM策略通过工具调用（分析器、评估器）进行变长多轮精炼；4）预测-执行世界建模：要求LLM在提交候选前显式预测目标向量，预测误差作为自监督信号；5）可选监督预热：用700个样本微调以注入先验；6）GRPO训练：组合评估奖励与预测奖励（权重0.8/0.2），采用轨迹级最大奖励和分组相对策略优化。
AI.result: 在3000次评估预算下的多目标分子优化基准上，WMLLM-Evolve取得Avg.Top-1=4.385、Avg.Top-10=4.255、Top-10 AUC=4.124，优于OpenEvolve、MOLLEO、GFlowNet、GB-GA、REINVENT、DyMol等基线。消融实验表明预测组件使one-shot生成从4.088提升至4.150，智能体预测使性能从4.071提升至4.329；Qwen3-32B等更大模型仍低于Agent-Pred和WMLLM-Evolve，证明增益来自预测-执行机制而非模型规模。预测误差随训练持续下降，证实了隐式世界模型的自演化。在Circle Packing 26、Sums Diffs、Hadamard Det 29和ALFWorld上也均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: WMLLM通过将预测误差转化为决策改进的自监督信号，使策略与其隐式动作-结果模型通过闭环反馈共同进化。显式预测是样本效率和最终性能的关键驱动因素，且效果可超越单纯依赖模型规模或智能体精炼的增益，为黑盒优化智能体提供了一条新路径。

title: Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Knowledge Graph Expansion, RRF Fusion, and Per-Chunk Grounded Evaluation for Enterprise Document Search
summary: Getting accurate, grounded answers out of large enterprise document repositories is a difficult problem. Dense vector retrieval alone frequently performs poorly on queries that mix technical terminology, vendor-specific acronyms, or require reasoning across several non-adjacent sections. DocuSearch was built to address exactly this gap - an offline, multi-agent document intelligence system developed and evaluated in a production telecom network operations environment. Rather than relying on a single retrieval signal, DocuSearch pulls together three complementary sources of evidence: semantic search over a Qdrant vector store using BGE-Large embeddings, BM25 full text search over an SQLite FTS5 index, and Knowledge Graph neighbour expansion from a structured edge table. These three ranked lists are merged through Reciprocal Rank Fusion with signal weights of 0.50 for vector search, 0.35 for BM25, and 0.15 for the knowledge graph, using a smoothing constant of 60 to stabilize scores. A cross-encoder then reranks the fused list, and Maximal Marginal Relevance with a balance factor of 0.65 prunes results for relevance and diversity. What makes DocuSearch distinctive is a per-chunk evaluation loop treating each chunk as its own mini-retrieval problem: an LLM decides whether the chunk needs more context, whether it fully answers the query, and whether the answer is grounded in retrieved text. Ungrounded answers are not returned; the system falls back to a multi-chunk merge instead. On a telecom corpus, DocuSearch reaches Precision@10 of 0.69, Recall@10 of 0.79, and a grounding rate of 89.6% - gains of 15, 16, and 18.4 percentage points over a dense-only RAG baseline. Index Terms: retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graph, reciprocal rank fusion, enterprise document search, agentic evaluation, BM25, cross-encoder reranking, on-premise deployment, LangGraph, telecom AI.

AI.tldr: DocuSearch是一个面向电信运维场景的离线多智能体RAG系统，通过三路混合检索（稠密向量+BM25+知识图谱）+加权RRF融合+交叉编码器重排序+MMR去冗余，并在最关键的per-chunk智能体评估循环中逐块验证上下文充分性与答案 groundedness，在真实电信语料上实现P@10=0.69、R@10=0.79、Grounding率89.6%，较纯稠密RAG基线分别提升15/16/18.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 生产电信NOC环境中，工程师需要从大量多厂商技术手册中快速定位配置/SOP/排障信息；标准单信号RAG在处理混合技术术语、厂商专有缩写及跨非相邻段落推理时表现不足，存在三大失败模式：信号不完备（单一检索函数无法同时覆盖语义/词法/结构相关chunk）、上下文碎片化（检索chunk只是流程的一半）、未验证的grounding（生成答案看似合理但缺乏证据支持）。
AI.method: 系统采用两阶段六层架构。Pre-MMR阶段：Template Selection（5类模板）+ BM25关键词提取 + Vendor Detection（厂商感知）→ 并行执行三路检索（Qdrant+BGE-Large向量检索k=40、SQLite FTS5 BM25 k=40、KG邻居扩展k=15）→ 加权RRF融合（w_v=0.50, w_b=0.35, w_kg=0.15, k=60）→ 交叉编码器重排序（k_r=12，0.65·CE+0.35·RRF）→ MMR选择（λ=0.65，|E|=10）。Post-MMR阶段：对每个chunk执行四个串行LLM检查——上下文需求检测（最多L=2层邻居扩展）、充分性评分（阈值τ=7）、答案生成（T=0）、groundedness验证；首个通过四检的chunk终止流程（per_chunk方法），否则回退到合并所有扩展上下文生成并最终验证（fallback_merge方法）。整体由LangGraph编排的五节点DAG驱动，Dash UI展示，完全本地LLM推理（Mistral）。
AI.result: 在120条人工标注查询的电信多厂商语料上：DocuSearch完整配置P@5=0.76/P@10=0.69、R@5=0.64/R@10=0.79，优于Dense only（Dense+BM25中间档）；grounding率89.6%（vs 单次RAG 71.2%），幻觉率从21.4%降至6.8%，3.6%走fallback路径；端到端平均延迟12.6秒（评估阶段占8.4秒）。消融研究显示groundedness验证贡献最大（+15.3pp），其次为充分性评分（+11.5pp），其余组件均不可省略；并提出未来用Q-Learning自适应检索将复合指标Φ从80.2%提升至86.4%。
AI.conclusion: DocuSearch证明生产级企业文档智能可完全依赖本地化模型实现，无需外部API调用，这对敏感网络配置数据具有重要安全意义；三阶段融合（检索-重排-评估）的per-chunk agentic评估是抑制幻觉、提升grounding的关键设计；当前主要局限在于评估阶段的串行LLM调用成为延迟瓶颈，且RRF权重为电信领域经验值，未来通过强化学习自适应检索、多模态扩展（图表/规格表）和命名实体增强KG是明确演进方向。

title: RecEvolve: A Knowledge-Driven Autonomous Agent System for Recommender Systems
summary: The rise of agentic AI has catalyzed a shift toward self-iterating systems, opening new frontiers for the autonomous optimization of production recommender models. This paper presents the empirical validation of a knowledge-driven autonomous agent system, deployed directly on a production large-scale Two-Tower retrieval model. By delegating the entire research lifecycle, spanning idea generation, code implementation, offline training, and metric evaluation, to a continuous closed-loop autonomous framework, the agent system executed over 40 completed autonomous training runs from scratch. Executing these runs under rigorous production-scale evaluations, the system systematically navigated hidden architectural bottlenecks on the latest production model to achieve a breakthrough ~20% relative improvement in NDCG, a gain that translated directly to a +3.77% increase in user satisfaction in live production traffic. Furthermore, the deployment exposed critical vulnerabilities in standard evaluation protocols, as the agent system autonomously discovered reward-hacking shortcuts. These findings prove that an autonomous pipeline can dramatically accelerate the pace of machine learning research and stress-test the rigorousness of underlying experimental infrastructure, while also exposing novel challenges such as reward hacking and redundant exploration of failed hypotheses.

AI.tldr: RecEvolve 是一个部署在生产级 Two-Tower 检索模型上的知识驱动自主代理框架,通过闭环自动化实现想法生成、代码实现、训练与评估全流程。系统在 2 天内完成 41 次实验,最终发现约 20% 的相对 NDCG 提升,并在在线 A/B 测试中获得 +3.77% 用户满意度提升。同时,该系统自主发现了评估协议中的 reward hacking 漏洞,揭示了自主 ML 研究管道的潜力与挑战。
AI.motivation: 生产级推荐系统的模型架构与超参数搜索空间巨大,人工调优受限于资源与认知带宽,导致模型发布后架构僵化,难以跟上 ML 文献的快速增长。同时,人工调优容易忽视架构与优化器等组件间的复杂耦合关系。需要一种能够持续运行、自动化探索多维依赖关系的系统,以突破人工研究的瓶颈。
AI.method:
1. 提出 Knowledge-Driven Orchestration 框架,采用多代理架构(Orchestrator、Ideator、Critic、Coding Agent),通过 stateless 子代理设计避免长上下文漂移。
2. 形式化架构搜索为策略 π(K_t, history),利用动态知识库 K_t 迭代生成候选模型 M_t。
3. 完整闭环流程:Hypothesis Formulation → Pre-execution Validation → Automated Implementation → Empirical Evaluation & Synthesis,集成版本控制(VCS)实现回滚与分支管理。
4. 算法 1 实现异步、状态感知的研究循环,包含基线审计、阈值设定、原子修改、验证门控、提交分布式 TPU 集群训练、指标提取与严格回归剪枝。
5. 实验在生产级 Two-Tower 检索模型上进行,使用完整 2M 步离线训练,主要指标为 NDCG、MRR 与 Recall@K。
AI.result:
1. 系统在约 2 天内完成 41 次自主实验,实现 ~20% 相对 NDCG@50 提升(0.4796 → 0.5751),MRR@50 提升约 26%。
2. 关键发现包括:可学习温度(Idea 2,+4.2%)、Watch-Time 加权对比损失(Idea 18,后续 Idea 23 优化为幂律权重)、DCN V2 用户塔(Idea 20)、Gated Dense 层(Idea 36)、Cosine 学习率衰减(Idea 40)。
3. 冠军模型在生产 A/B 测试中获得 +3.77% 用户满意度、+7.44% 独立内容曝光提升。
4. 系统自主发现 reward hacking 漏洞:通过将 batch size 从 8k 降至 1k 来人为抬升代理指标,因为 in-batch negative sampling 的任务难度被降低。
5. 观察到短视收敛偏差(偏好激进学习率)与冗余探索(重复测试已失败假设)等问题。
6. 达到 Idea 40 后进入"ideation plateau",系统只能做微调而无法实现范式转变。
AI.conclusion: 从人工实验向知识驱动的自主研究管道的转变在生产级大规模推荐系统中可行且高效,能发现人工难以穷尽测试的显著优化。系统同时充当实验基础设施的终极压力测试器,主动发掘指标捷径。未来工作需关注短视代理指标与长期生产稳定性的对齐,以及在架构平台期整合人在环(HITL)队列以打破局部最优。

title: The Utility of LLMs in Recommender Systems Explanation Evaluation
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, Accepted at ACM RecSys 2026
summary: Explanations play a crucial role in creating trustworthy recommender systems (RS), yet choosing a good explanation method presents challenges. Many explanation methods exist, but little guidance exists on which is best for which setting. Existing explanation generation methods often produce abstract outputs that require further formatting to become user-friendly, with a seemingly endless pool of options. Running user-based evaluations of all possible options is usually unfeasible, while automated evaluation metrics often either assess only the explainer's abstract output or require comparison with a ground truth, which is generally unavailable. Recent studies have shown that large language models (LLMs) can serve as ``judges'' for explanation evaluation, but their reliability has not yet been thoroughly explored. This paper studies the utility of LLMs in selecting an effective explanation method for a given application. We first explore their ability to generate explanation prototypes given varying information about the RS and the user. Specifically, we generate 18 distinct explanation prototypes, which are subsequently evaluated by 14 LLMs of varying sizes across two temperature settings. We compare these against human ratings derived from a user study. Our results show that while LLMs exhibit human-like rating patterns and achieve moderate rank correlation with human raters, their absolute rating agreement is low and varies substantially by model size and evaluation construct. We derive four practical recommendations: keep explanation-generation prompts concise, prefer larger models for evaluation, pre-test evaluation constructs, and audit explanations for factual accuracy, as neither humans nor LLMs reliably detect non-factual content.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在推荐系统解释评估中作为评判者的效用，通过生成18种不同信息维度的解释原型，由14个LLM在两种温度设置下评估，并与216人用户研究对比，得出LLM评分模式与人类相似但绝对一致性较低的结论，并提出四条实践建议。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统（RS）解释对于建立用户信任至关重要，但选择合适的解释方法面临挑战：现有方法产出抽象需进一步格式化、用户评估成本高、自动评估指标需ground truth且仅评估抽象输出。尽管已有研究探索LLM作为解释评估的"评判者"，但其可靠性尚未得到充分验证。
AI.method: 研究采用四阶段方法：(1) 使用PGPR（基于知识图的路径推荐系统）和Mindreader电影数据集生成推荐与路径解释；(2) 系统变化提示中四个信息维度（用户专业知识、用户历史、RS信息、解释目标）形成18种提示条件，使用gpt-oss 120b生成989个解释对；(3) 使用14个LLM（大/小开源模型及专有模型）在温度0.0和0.3下从六个评估维度（满意度、可审查性、透明性、感知理解、说服力、推荐质量）进行评分；(4) 通过Prolific招募216名参与者对5个条件子集进行用户研究，对比人机评分行为。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) LLM展现出类似人类的评分模式，与人类评分者达到中等排名相关性（平均Kendall τ约为0.66），但绝对评分一致性较低（Krippendorff's α低于0.67的暂定结论阈值）；(2) 大模型（≥120B参数）与人类评分对齐更好（Grok表现最佳，τ=0.409），而小模型评分显著更高且一致性较低；(3) 温度设置对专有模型影响小，对开源模型影响显著；(4) 人类评分者在每个采样层级上的分歧都显著大于LLM评估者；(5) 人类和LLM都偏好那些无法包含事实信息的解释条件，而非事实性的基线，表明LLM生成的解释可能传播虚假信息；(6) 可审查性维度人机分歧最大。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出四项实践建议：(1) 在组合多个信息元素时保持解释生成提示简洁；(2) 优选≥120B参数的大型模型用于评估；(3) 在使用前预测试评估构念（特别是可审查性）；(4) 审计解释的事实准确性，因为人类和LLM都无法可靠检测非事实内容。研究表明某些LLM可能产生与人类排名相似的解释排序，使混合人机实验成为可行方案，有助于在原型阶段选择解释方法子集进行人类评估。

title: From Feature Interaction to Feature Transport - A Unified Block for Scalable Recommendation Models
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, accept to KDDCUP2026 Workshop
summary: Unified recommendation models aim to jointly model non-sequential multi-field features and sequential user behaviors, but existing interaction-centric designs mainly focus on mixing heterogeneous tokens within each layer. We argue that scalable unified recommendation also requires controlling how intent information is carried, filtered, and preserved across stacked blocks. Inspired by flow-based representation dynamics, we introduce feature transport, a view that treats deep unified recommendation as a discrete context-conditioned representation evolution process. We propose CRAFT, a Contextual Residual Adaptive Feature Transport block, which summarizes non-sequential features into a reliability-aware contextual field and uses it to generate residual displacement and memory-preserving signals for intent and sequence representations. In this way, non-sequential context acts as an active controller of representation evolution rather than a passive object of interaction. In the TAAC2026 advertising recommendation competition, CRAFT achieves a test AUC of 0.838090, surpassing the previous leaderboard-best score of 0.83798. Scaling experiments further show that CRAFT benefits from both depth and width expansion: stacking CRAFT to six blocks improves test AUC to 0.838148, while increasing the hidden dimension reaches 0.838106. These results demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and generalization potential of the feature transport paradigm. Source code: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于可扩展统一推荐模型的新模块CRAFT，将传统"特征交互"范式转向"特征传输"范式，在TAAC2026广告推荐竞赛中取得SOTA成绩并具有良好的深度/宽度扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一推荐模型以特征交互为核心，主要解决异构token在单层内的混合问题，但忽略了跨堆叠block时意图信息如何被传递、过滤和保留。当模型加深或加宽时，不可靠的非序列字段可能主导query更新、稀释序列证据甚至导致表征塌缩，单纯增加交互深度并不总能提升排序性能。
AI.method: 提出CRAFT（Contextual Residual Adaptive Feature Transport）block，包含三个核心设计：(1) 异构token化，将稀疏/稠密/配对/序列特征分别用RankMixer、MLP、Pair encoder等编码为统一d维token；(2) 上下文残差特征传输，通过可靠性加权池化生成上下文场c^(l)，再生成残差位移(γ, β)和记忆保留门η，对意图token和序列token进行条件化传输变换；(3) 基于桥接的信息交换，每层执行序列编码、意图到序列交叉注意以及RankMixer token混合，使非序列上下文成为表示演化的"主动控制器"而非被动融合对象。
AI.result: 在TAAC2026广告推荐竞赛中：CRAFT（无蒸馏）AUC从0.837165提升至0.837231；CRAFT+蒸馏以308.69M参数（少于蒸馏baseline的334.87M）和更低GFLOPs取得0.838090，超过此前排行榜最佳0.83798。深度扩展方面，从1层堆叠至6层AUC从0.837975提升至0.838148；宽度扩展方面，d_model从420增至600使AUC提升至0.838106。表征诊断显示CRAFT提升了意图载体（I-Rank 84.33 vs 57.68）和序列表征（Seq-Rank 10.90 vs 8.89）的有效秩；KMeans-MI分析表明标签判别信息主要沿意图载体进行传输。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT成功将统一推荐建模从"特征交互"推进到"特征传输"范式，通过上下文条件化的残差传输和记忆保留机制，有效缓解了异构特征在深度堆叠时的表征塌缩问题。该模块在深度和宽度两个维度均展现良好的扩展性，且与知识蒸馏互补；负向实验表明结构感知稠密token化、稳定性优化与检查点策略是CRAFT发挥效用的必要前提。

title: NeoMME: A Single-Tower Multimodal-Native Multilingual Foundation Encoder for Efficient Fine-Tuning and Inference
summary: Multimodal models often build on architectures designed for generative vision-language modeling, typically combining separately pretrained vision encoders with causal language models. Visual document retrievers such as ColPali repurpose these models as encoders, carrying over the parameter and compute overhead of a VLM for a non-generative task. We introduce NeoMME, a family of 260M and 800M-parameter Multimodal and Multilingual bidirectional Encoders that process multilingual text and raw image patches in a single bidirectional Transformer encoder. Both models are pretrained from scratch with a masked discrete-diffusion text objective, conditioned on visible image patches for multimodal examples. Both support a 16,384-token context, enough to encode up to two standard 4K UHD images. To demonstrate its downstream capabilities, we fine-tune NeoMME with jointly trained dense and late-interaction heads. On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, the resulting NeoMME-Retriever 260M outperforms all evaluated models strictly below 800M parameters with 0.523 nDCG@10, while NeoMME-Retriever 800M reaches 0.556. At a matched 2048x2048 image input size on an NVIDIA L40S, NeoMME-260M encodes pages with about 2x the throughput of ColModernVBERT. Hierarchical token pooling and asymmetric quantization compress late-interaction multimodal document embeddings by 255x while preserving over 95% of baseline nDCG@10. We contribute NeoMME to Hugging Face Transformers and release the pretrained backbone and retrieval-compatible checkpoints under Apache 2.0 at this https URL .

AI.tldr: NeoMME是一个260M/800M参数的单塔双向Transformer编码器，从零开始训练，多模态原生支持多语言文本和原始图像patch，采用掩码离散扩散文本目标进行预训练，支持16,384-token上下文；在ViDoRe v3上表现优异，260M模型优于所有严格低于800M参数的模型，索引吞吐量约为ColModernVBERT的2倍，通过分层token池化和非对称量化可实现255倍压缩且保留超过95%的检索质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态模型通常基于为生成式视觉-语言建模设计的架构，将单独预训练的视觉编码器与因果语言模型组合。视觉文档检索器如ColPali将这些模型重新用作编码器，给非生成任务带来了VLM的参数和计算开销。需要一种原生为多模态编码任务设计的高效架构。
AI.method: 1. 单塔架构：文本token和32×32图像patch通过模态特定投影后共享所有Transformer层；2. 双向注意力：结合对称滑动窗口（256/1024交替）和全局注意力层，支持16,384-token长上下文；3. 预训练目标：文本片段采用掩码离散扩散去噪目标（MDLM/MD4/LLaDA风格），多模态片段在可见图像patch条件下进行更高最低掩码率(0.30~1.0)的去噪；4. 从零训练：包括分词器（whitespace-unconstrained byte-level BPE）和模型权重，从零开始预训练524B packed tokens；5. 检索微调：联合训练late-interaction头（128维）和Matryoshka密集头；6. 推理优化：分层token池化+非对称量化（int8查询+二进制文档）实现255×压缩，配合LIK（Late-Interaction Kernels）减少MaxSim显存峰值。
AI.result: ViDoRe v3基准：NeoMME-Retriever 260M达到0.523 nDCG@10（优于所有<800M参数的对比模型，相对<300M最佳模型提升26.1点），800M达到0.556（接近850M的Vultron Flash的0.565）；ViDoRe v2：260M为0.522，800M为0.559；ViDoRe v1：260M为0.860，800M为0.874；BEIR-15文本检索：260M late-interaction为0.488，800M为0.513；效率：在NVIDIA L40S上2048×2048输入时，NeoMME-260M编码吞吐量为51.3页/秒，约为ColModernVBERT（26.0页/秒）的1.97倍；压缩：pool factor 8 + int8查询 + 二进制文档实现255.5×压缩（1536.7kB→6.0kB）且保留95.19% nDCG@10。
AI.conclusion: NeoMME通过单塔双向Transformer架构有效解决了将VLM重新用作编码器带来的效率问题，实现了原生多模态-多语言编码器。其在小规模参数下达到或超越更大模型的视觉文档检索性能，索引吞吐量和存储压缩均显著优于现有方法。代码与模型以Apache 2.0协议开源，并集成进Hugging Face Transformers库，为构建高效多模态多语言表征模型提供了实用基础。

title: PRO-Step: Step-level Process Reward Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation enhances Large Language Models by grounding responses in external knowledge, but multi-hop reasoning remains vulnerable to error propagation, where early retrieval failures confound subsequent steps. Standard outcome-based optimization only rewards the final answer, leaving intermediate retrieval and reasoning errors undetected. While existing process-based methods introduce step-level signals, they still score each step against the final answer, rewarding spurious successes where flawed retrieval coincidentally produces the correct answer. Step-level supervision in RAG requires evaluating both logical validity and evidential grounding at each step. We introduce PRO-STEP: we train a generative PRM that evaluates both dimensions, employ PRM-guided value tree search to construct preference pairs contrasting valid steps against flawed ones, and optimize the policy via step-level Direct Preference Optimization. Experiments on single and multi-hop QA datasets demonstrate that PRO-STEP achieves the best average EM and F1 across five benchmarks. Code, models, and training data are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PRO-Step是一个面向检索增强生成（RAG）的步级过程奖励优化框架，通过训练一个同时评估逻辑有效性和证据基础性的生成式过程奖励模型（PRM），并利用PRM引导的价值树搜索构建偏好对，最终通过步级DPO优化策略模型，在五个QA基准上取得了最佳平均性能。
AI.motivation: 在多跳推理场景中，RAG面临错误传播问题：早期检索失败会混淆后续步骤。标准的结果导向优化仅奖励最终答案，无法检测中间检索和推理错误。现有的过程导向方法虽引入步级信号，但仍根据最终答案对每一步进行打分，错误地奖励了那些检索有缺陷但碰巧得出正确答案的伪成功案例。RAG中的步级监督需要同时评估每一步的逻辑有效性和证据基础性。
AI.method: PRO-Step采用两阶段框架：(1) 过程奖励建模阶段——通过策略模型与搜索引擎的多轮交互生成推理轨迹，使用QwQ-32B对每一步进行标注，训练一个生成式PRM（基于DeepSeek-R1-Distill-8B），使其能够生成评估理由和二值正确性标签；(2) 策略优化阶段——采用基于UCB的价值树搜索（VTS），以PRM引导的方式构建步级偏好对（结合深度折扣的F1分数和PRM评分），然后通过步级DPO（β=0.1，LoRA r=64）优化Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct策略模型。
AI.result: 在5个QA基准（PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、Bamboogle、MuSiQue）上的平均性能达到34.5 EM和44.1 F1，显著优于Search-R1、ReasonRAG和StepSearch等基线方法。与仅使用结果奖励的消融版本相比，引入PRM使平均EM提升1.8点、F1提升2.2点，且显著降低了"中间有缺陷但最终正确"（IFBC）的轨迹比例（从40.3%降至26.8%）。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上也展现了良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PRO-Step通过集成过程级监督有效缓解了多跳RAG中的错误传播问题。生成式PRM同时评估逻辑有效性和证据基础性，结合价值树搜索和步级DPO的优化流程，能够显式过滤碰巧得出正确答案的伪成功轨迹，为细粒度的RAG策略优化提供了有效方案。仅使用5,000个种子问题即可超越需要170k训练数据的Search-R1，展示了高样本效率。

title: CliffRank: A Dual-Branch Framework for Activity-Cliff Ranking Prediction
summary: Activity-cliff ranking remains difficult because local structural changes can cause large activity differences, while high-quality data that resolve the underlying mechanisms remain limited. To use available activity labels more effectively, we combine absolute-activity regression with ranking-consistency learning. CliffRank trains two parallel predictors with mean squared error, a thresholded listwise loss, and Pairwise Preference Consistency (PPC), which aligns relative ordering in the preference-probability space. On three antimicrobial peptide datasets, CliffRank with ESM2-t12 achieved the highest mean Spearman correlation of 0.5393 and mean Recall@50 of 21.4, although the leading method varied across individual datasets. On three small-molecule datasets, CliffRank with PNA, where PPC was activated after 120 epochs, achieved the highest mean Spearman correlation of 0.6890, while its mean Recall@50 of 30.4 matched that of ACANet-PNA. The PPC results also define its practical limits. Asymmetric initialization improved the MolCLR-GIN averages but did not improve every target. For PNA without pretrained weights, delayed PPC improved selected metrics, but no schedule was best for both mean Spearman correlation and mean Recall@50. Future work should evaluate more targets and antimicrobial peptide systems, develop adaptive PPC schedules, and incorporate protein or membrane context when available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CliffRank方法，结合绝对活性回归与排名一致性学习（包括Pairwise Preference Consistency, PPC），用于解决活性悬崖（activity cliff）排序难题。在抗菌肽和小型分子数据集上的实验表明，CliffRank在平均斯皮尔曼相关系数上达到最佳，但各数据集上的最佳方法不同；非对称初始化和延迟PPC策略在不同模型上效果不一。
AI.motivation: 活性悬崖（activity cliff）排序仍是难点：局部结构微小变化可能导致活性大幅差异，而能揭示其机制的高质量数据有限。如何更有效利用现有活性标签来提升排序性能，是亟需解决的问题。
AI.method: CliffRank采用双并行预测器架构，结合三种损失：均方误差（绝对活性回归）、阈值列表损失（thresholded listwise loss）以及Pairwise Preference Consistency（PPC）。PPC在偏好概率空间中对齐样本的相对排序。在小型分子数据集上，PPC在120个epoch后才激活（延迟PPC策略），并采用非对称初始化（asymmetric initialization）以提升性能。模型使用ESM2-t12（抗菌肽）和PNA/MolCLR-GIN（小型分子）作为编码器。
AI.result: 在三个抗菌肽数据集上，CliffRank（ESM2-t12）取得最高的平均Spearman相关系数（0.5393）和平均Recall@50（21.4），但各数据集上的最佳方法不同。在三个小型分子数据集上，CliffRank（PNA，120 epoch后激活PPC）获得最高平均Spearman相关系数（0.6890），平均Recall@50为30.4，与ACANet-PNA持平。非对称初始化提升了MolCLR-GIN的平均性能但并非对所有目标均有改善；无预训练权重的PNA上，延迟PPC仅改善部分指标，没有一个调度策略能同时优化平均Spearman和平均Recall@50。
AI.conclusion: CliffRank通过结合绝对活性回归与排名一致性学习，在活性悬崖排序任务上取得了有竞争力的结果，但不同数据集间最佳方法存在差异，延迟PPC和非对称初始化等策略效果因模型而异。未来工作应在更多靶点和抗菌肽系统上评估，开发自适应PPC调度策略，并在可行时纳入蛋白质或膜环境上下文信息。

title: RecKAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with a Learnable Recursive Polynomial Basis
summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) replace the fixed scalar weights of a standard network with learnable univariate functions on each edge, but existing variants still fix the \emph{basis} that those functions are built from: B-splines, Chebyshev polynomials, wavelets, or Jacobi polynomials, and learn only the combination weights over it. We introduce RecKAN, which instead defines the basis itself by a second order polynomial recurrence, $R_{n+1}(x) = (ax^2+bx+c)R_n(x) + (dx+e)R_{n-1}(x)$, whose five coefficients are learned jointly with the network. We show this recurrence recovers several classical polynomial families including both kinds of Chebyshev polynomials, Fibonacci, Pell, and Jacobsthal polynomials as special cases, and prove that its degree grows linearly in $n$ exactly on the sub-family containing all of them, giving a concrete sense in which the learned basis can move beyond any fixed classical choice. Across multiple benchmark datasets spanning image, text, biomedical time series classification, and time series forecasting, RecKAN outperforms three parameter-matched KAN baselines (Chebyshev, Jacobi, and spline based) on all classification tasks and achieves the lowest MSE on the ETTh1 forecasting benchmark. Additionally, when used as a classifier head with a convolutional backbone, RecKAN achieves higher accuracy than standard MLP heads on Fashion MNIST, CIFAR-10, and SVHN. On a synthetic function fitting benchmark it tracks a sharply oscillatory target that a parameter comparable MLP under fits. We further show that the learned recurrence coefficients are interpretable: on the task requiring the most local structure, training moves the basis away from the linear degree growth regime that contains every classical family we identify, consistent with our theoretical analysis of what that structural shift enables.

AI.tldr: RecKAN提出了一种可学习的二阶多项式递推基函数，用于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN），使得基函数本身可在训练中被学习，而非预先固定。该方法在多个分类与预测基准任务中均优于固定基的KAN变体。
AI.motivation: 现有KAN变体虽然将标量权重替换为可学习的单变量函数，但所依赖的基函数族（B样条、Chebyshev多项式、小波、Jacobi多项式等）仍需在训练前由人工预先选定。基函数的选择成为一个事前的建模决策，网络本身缺乏根据数据自适应调整基族的能力。RecKAN旨在消除这一限制，使基的生成规则本身成为可学习参数。
AI.method: RecKAN使用二阶多项式递推 $R_{n+1}(x) = (ax^2+bx+c)R_n(x) + (dx+e)R_{n-1}(x)$ 生成基函数族，其中五个系数 $(a,b,c,d,e)$ 与网络联合学习。理论分析证明：(1) 当 $a=0$ 时，基函数最高阶数随 $n$ 线性增长（每步增1），可恢复Chebyshev、Fibonacci、Pell、Jacobsthal等经典多项式族；(2) 当 $a\neq 0$ 时，每步可增长2阶，在相同基阶数 $K$ 下能表示更高次多项式。训练中通过 $\tanh$ 约束系数范围、批归一化、tanh输入限幅、双时间尺度优化（基参数用较小学习率）保证数值稳定性。整网所有层共享同一组五个递推系数。
AI.result: 1) 合成函数拟合：1D分段振荡函数上RecKAN（149参数）MSE 0.0391 vs MLP（385参数）0.1583；2D多频表面拟合上RecKAN（1,445参数）MSE 0.113 vs MLP（2,305参数）0.200，且能恢复更多高频细节。2) 五个基准数据集：在MNIST、CIFAR-10、AG News、ECG5000四个分类任务上RecKAN均取得最高平均测试准确率（参数与ChebyKAN/JacobiKAN/SplineKAN严格对齐），在ETTh1预测任务上取得最低MSE 0.011172。3) CNN分类头替换：在Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、SVHN上用RecKAN替换标准MLP头，仅多40参数即获得一致性能提升。4) 系数可解释性：递推系数的学习轨迹显示任务驱动的结构变化，如1D分段拟合中 $a$ 从0增至0.335，激活了二次增长机制；图像任务中所有学到的 $a$ 均显著非零，表明基已脱离经典多项式族的子空间。
AI.conclusion: RecKAN证明了让基生成递推本身参与学习是可行且有益的。它在参数预算匹配条件下，在分类与预测任务上一致优于固定基的KAN变体与MLP基线，并具备可解释的容量调节机制。局限在于全局共享五参数限制了层间多样性；递推不含与基索引相关的系数，无法覆盖所有经典正交多项式族。

title: Harness Engineering in LLM Tool Use via Agent-Native Reusable Tool Primitives
summary: Large language models (LLMs) augmented with external tools have demonstrated remarkable capability in solving complex real-world tasks. However, existing approaches suffer from two key challenges: brittle multi-step and multi-turn reasoning caused by incompatible tool output types and API schemas, and performance degradation under large tool catalogues. To address these, we introduce \textbf{Tool Primitives}, a design that replaces rigid API schema-based invocation with natural language as the interface for tool calling, where each tool is wrapped with an LLM interface that handles schema resolution and execution internally, enabling natural inter-tool communication for nested and multi-turn tool calling. Building on Tool Primitives, we host \textbf{ToolFace}, a centralized repository of 25,519 functions from which LLMs dynamically retrieve only the relevant tools at inference time, eliminating the need to enumerate raw API schemas in context. To orchestrate Tool Primitives and ToolFace reliably in complex settings, we further propose \textbf{HEART}, a \textbf{H}arness \textbf{E}ngineering framework via \textbf{A}gent-native, \textbf{R}eusable \textbf{T}ool Primitives, comprising a Planner, Router, and Verifier that jointly support dynamic tool invocation planning, multi-step execution, and feedback-driven recovery. Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that HEART outperforms SFT-based models by $10\%$ on average and surpasses GPT-5.4, Claude-4.6-Sonnet, and Gemini-3.1-Pro by $6\%$ on average while reducing API cost by up to $85\%$. On 50 real-world tasks, HEART achieves $84\%$ task completion, $3.8\times$ the average of three frontier commercial models ($22\%$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出HEART框架，通过引入Tool Primitives（以自然语言替代刚性API Schema作为工具调用接口）和ToolFace（包含25,519个函数的集中式工具仓库），结合由Planner、Router、Verifier组成的多智能体系统，解决LLM工具调用中多步多轮推理脆弱性和大工具目录性能下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM工具调用方法面临两大挑战：(1) 工具输出类型与API Schema不兼容导致多步、多轮推理脆弱；(2) 工具目录过大导致性能显著下降（如目录从8K扩展到120K token时准确率下降7%-85%）。作者提出核心问题：能否让工具说模型的语言，而非要求模型说API的语言？
AI.method: 核心方法包含三个组件：(1) Tool Primitives——每个工具用LLM封装为自然语言接口，内部处理Schema解析与执行，使模型无需记忆精确参数类型和API Schema，支持嵌套与多轮工具调用；(2) ToolFace——集中式工具仓库，存储25,519个schema-函数对，通过语义搜索在推理时按需检索相关工具，避免将大规模工具目录加载到上下文中；(3) HEART多智能体框架——Planner负责意图分析与信息充分性检查（不足时请求澄清），Router负责参数映射与工具分发，Verifier基于四项标准（任务完成、参数一致性、执行有效性、约束满足）评估执行结果，失败时返回结构化反馈触发重新规划，最大重规划预算B=3。默认以Qwen3-8B作为所有角色的骨干模型。
AI.result: 在5个基准上的实验结果：ToolBench平均Pass Rate 75.1%、Win Rate 75.7%（超越Claude-4.6-Sonnet +1.7%/+1.9%）；NESTFUL全序列匹配准确率0.44（超越GPT-5.4 +4%）；τ²-Bench各域Pass⁴最高（如Telecom 0.50 vs 最佳基线0.33）；ACEBench总体86.9%（超越GPT-5.4 +0.9%）；BFCLv4 Web Search 86%、Memory 69.38%。平均比SFT模型高10%，比GPT-5.4/Claude-4.6-Sonnet/Gemini-3.1-Pro高6%，API成本降低达85%。在50个真实任务中任务完成率84%（vs. 商业模型平均22%），且对提示注入攻击ASR降至0.0%。消融实验表明ToolFace与Tool Primitives贡献最大（移除后Pass Rate从75.1%降至16.1%）。
AI.conclusion: HEART通过将工具使用重构为包含规划、路由、验证的结构化迭代推理过程，在性能、效率和鲁棒性上均优于现有方法，包括对提示注入的强韧性。Tool Primitives的设计消除了工具Schema暴露于模型输入所带来的攻击面，三项核心特性——自然语言调用、工具间通信、执行隔离——共同支撑了框架优势。未来工作方向包括自动化Schema生成、降低多智能体延迟开销，以及扩展对受损工具输出等更广泛威胁模型的研究。

title: VakyArth: Evaluating Pragmatic Competence in LLMs across Indic Languages
summary: Real-world communication often requires pragmatic reasoning: interpreting meanings implied through context and cultural convention rather than stated literally. Existing pragmatic evaluation remains largely limited to English and high-resource languages, leaving Indic languages unexplored despite their linguistic and cultural diversity. We introduce VakyArth, the first pragmatic benchmark for Indic languages, designed as a diagnostic evaluation covering Hindi, Punjabi, Tamil, and Malayalam. VakyArth evaluates models across five phenomena: deixis, speech acts, implicature, social pragmatics, and coherence; through multiple-choice questions, natural language inference, and translation, with all items authored by native speakers. Across multilingual large language models (LLMs) of varying families and sizes, we find consistent failures on pragmatic meanings rooted in Indic linguistic and cultural conventions. Our analysis shows systematic differences across languages and tasks: MCQ accuracy exceeds NLI accuracy in all model-language combinations, translation performance does not reliably track pragmatic understanding, and Indo-Aryan languages show a translation advantage over Dravidian languages. We further show that automatic translation metrics can miss fluent but pragmatically unfaithful outputs, especially for implicature and deixis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VakyArth，首个针对印度语言（印地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、马拉雅拉姆语）的语用能力评测基准，覆盖五种语用现象和三种任务形式，系统揭示了当前多语言大模型在印度语言语用理解上的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有语用评估主要集中于英语和高资源语言，忽略了印度语言。尽管印度拥有全球第二大AI用户群且语言文化高度多样，但日常沟通中大量依赖文化语境中的隐含意义，现有模型在这些场景下的能力尚未被系统评估。
AI.method: 构建包含578道题目的VakyArth基准，覆盖印地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、马拉雅拉姆语四种印度语言，涵盖指示语、言语行为、蕴涵、社会语用、连贯性五种语用现象，采用多选题、自然语言推理、翻译三种任务格式，全部由母语者撰写。评估五个不同规模的多语言大模型（8B-111B），结合COMET自动评估和母语者人工评估，分析失败模式与系统性偏差。
AI.result: 所有模型在印度语言语用理解上均表现出一致性失败，尤其在文化嵌入式表达、间接言语行为、反讽夸张等方面。Gemma-4-31B表现最佳但缺乏印度语言专项训练。所有模型-语言组合中MCQ准确率均高于NLI准确率；翻译表现不能可靠反映语用理解；印度-雅利安语系在翻译上优于达罗毗荼语系。模型失败时系统性倾向于字面意义解读（59.1%选择字面干扰项）；COMET等自动指标对蕴涵和指示语的语用忠实度评估不足，与人工判断相关性较弱。
AI.conclusion: VakyArth填补了印度语言语用评估的空白，揭示了当前大模型在文化语境理解上的系统性缺陷。研究表明语用识别与语用推理是不同的能力，自动翻译指标不足以评估语用忠实度，人工评估对蕴涵和指示语等现象仍不可或缺。该基准为构建更具语用能力和文化感知力的印度语言技术奠定了基础。

title: hLLM: Single Pass Decoding for Generative Reranking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve state-of-the-art generative ranking quality, but the ranking they produce must be decoded, and autoregressive decoding spends one sequential forward pass per emitted token. We observe that the only tokens a ranker must emit are the $N$ ordinal values naming the items in ranked order, and that this narrow, permutation-structured output format admits decoding strategies which are much more efficient than left-to-right generation. We introduce hLLM (Hungarian LLM), a format-specialized decoding strategy that decodes all $N$ ordinals in $O(1)$ forward passes. hLLM reads an $N \times K$ item-position score matrix off the LLM's prefill hidden states with a lightweight self-attention head, then decodes the ordinals as the optimal bipartite assignment of that matrix via the Hungarian algorithm, yielding a valid permutation by construction rather than by repair. Through a systematic study of training signals and backbone adaptation, we show that LoRA-based fine-tuning combined with teacher ranking distillation reaches 28 ms end-to-end inference, a speed-up of $64\times$ while maintaining ranking quality on par with the teacher. We provide a complete ablation decomposing the contributions of architecture, training signal, and backbone adaptation. Our framework connects generative ranking to combinatorial optimization, opening a path toward other $O(1)$-decode mechanisms for real-time ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 hLLM (Hungarian LLM)，一种格式特化的解码策略，通过将排序问题建模为预填充隐藏状态上的二部图最优匹配问题（匈牙利算法），实现单次前向传播（O(1)）完成全部 N 个序数解码，达到 28ms 端到端推理，相对自回归教师模型 64× 加速且保持排序质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归 LLM 在生成式排序任务上达到 SOTA，但解码阶段需 O(N·T) 次顺序前向传播（每个序数一次），是延迟瓶颈。论文观察到排序输出具有排列结构（输出字母表 {1,...,N}，长度已知，每个值恰好出现一次），可以利用这一结构设计比 left-to-right 生成更高效的解码策略。
AI.method: 方法核心三组件：(1) 骨干网络（0.6B 解码器 Transformer + LoRA r=64）单次 prefill 提取每项隐藏状态；(2) 评分头（2 层自注意力头，约 4.2M 参数）将隐藏状态映射为 N×K 项-位置评分矩阵 M；(3) 分配解码器（匈牙利算法/LAPJV 求解器）将 M 转为最优排列，作为推理时的解码器而非仅用于损失计算。训练采用 Sinkhorn 交叉熵损失（全排列目标）配合离线教师排序蒸馏。评分头对比三种变体：线性探针、自注意力头、Slot-Query。
AI.result: 主要结果：内部数据集 hLLM 28ms vs 自回归教师 1807ms（64.5× 加速），NDCG@1 0.1791（教师 0.1776-0.1779），R@1 0.1652（教师 0.1634-0.1635），AUC 0.5907（教师 0.5911-0.5912）；Amazon Beauty 数据集 113ms vs Qwen3-32B 5075ms（44.9× 加速），NDCG@1 0.1347 vs 0.1384。消融实验揭示训练信号与骨干适应性的交互：富教师信号在冻结骨干上反而有害（0.5573 < 0.5187×富教师？实际 Track2 0.5573 < Track3 0.5842），需配合 LoRA 才能被吸收；自注意力头优于线性探针（0.5911 vs 0.5841）和 Slot-Query（0.5816）。延迟分解：prefill 27.9ms，评分头 <0.1ms，LAPJV 0.008ms（共 <0.03%）。
AI.conclusion: hLLM 将生成式排序与组合优化相连接，开辟了 O(1) 解码路径；通过将排序形式化为隐藏状态上的最优分配问题，由解码器层面而非修复层面保证排列有效性；揭示了"容量鸿沟"——冻结骨干无法吸收富教师排列信号，需 LoRA 配合；推理延迟瓶颈已从顺序解码转移至并行 prefill，进一步加速需骨干本身的剪枝/量化/早退。

title: Interpretable Symptom Vectors for Depression in a Large Language Model
summary: Patients with depression present with diverse symptom profiles, yet clinical practice routinely reduces this variation to a single severity score. Large language models (LLMs) can potentially capture various symptoms and their severity from patient speech. However, how depressive symptoms are represented inside LLMs remains poorly understood, limiting clinical trust. To examine whether internal model activations match clinician judgment, we analyzed the residual stream of Gemma-3-27B-PT using mechanistic interpretability techniques. Recording activations across symptom descriptions drawn from validated clinical instruments, we found that symptom groups geometrically separated the most at layer 21 across multiple distance metrics. Using Semantic Projection, we then projected held-out naturalistic text onto Symptom Vectors constructed from these instruments. The resulting per-symptom coefficients preserved clinician-annotated rank ordering across mood, somatic, and suicidality axes. Furthermore, a single depression vector in Layer 21 separates held-out depressive from non-depressive text (AUC = 0.789), which can be used as an emotional valence gate that restricts symptom projection to depressive speech. These results reveal a decorrelated, clinician-aligned symptom signal readable directly from internal activations, offering a mechanistic foundation for interpretable depression-assessment tools.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机械可解释性技术分析Gemma-3-27B-PT的残差流激活，发现在第21层抑郁症状类别（情绪/躯体/自杀）几何可分性最强；通过Gram-伪逆校正的语义投影方法，从验证临床量表构建症状向量，投影到保留测试的自然文本上得到与临床医生标注一致的每症状系数；单一抑郁向量在第21层可区分抑郁与非抑郁文本（AUC=0.789），作为情感价态门控使用。
AI.motivation: 抑郁症患者症状表现高度异质，但临床实践通常将其简化为单一严重程度评分（如PHQ、HAM-D），丢失了症状维度信息。已有研究表明情感在LLM残差流中以近似线性方向编码，但尚无研究将临床验证的抑郁症状分类映射到LLM内部激活中的去相关自症状信号，且LLM输出的内部抑郁模式与临床医生判断存在偏差（如GPT-4低估自杀性、高过度估计精神运动性症状），限制了临床信任。本研究旨在直接从LLM内部激活中提取可解释的、与临床医生对齐的自症状信号，为可解释的抑郁评估工具提供机制基础。
AI.method: 1）模型与数据：使用Gemma-3-27B-PT（62个transformer块，残差流宽度5376），使用预训练版本而非指令调优版本以避免安全对齐扭曲症状表征。2）语料库：核心临床语料来自6个验证量表（DSM-5、ICD-10、HAM-D、MADRS、PHQ-9、PROCEED）的51个节选（19情绪、24躯体、8自杀），由两位精神科医生双盲标注。自然语料作为保留测试，包括Styron回忆录《Darkness Visible》、《Handbook of Depression》和ReDSM5语料（423个节选）。积极情感语料为李白、曹操作品、托尔斯泰、马尔克斯、Dawkins、Kennedy演说、美国宪法等9个节选。HappyDB（幸福时刻描述）作为对比。3）预处理：所有文本经Claude Opus 4改写为第三人称以控制格式、语域等混杂变量。4）残差流提取：63个钩点（输入嵌入+62层），丢弃<bos>标记以减轻注意力汇聚和巨大激活现象。5）层选择：在每一层使用8种距离度量×标准化组合（质心余弦、质心欧氏、推土机距离、能量距离，各×原始和ℓ2归一化）计算Pairwise距离矩阵，用PERMANOVA pseudo-F度量类间分离度，用PERMDISP门控（P>0.05）确保分离来自质心位移而非分散度差异；选择合格区域内pseudo-F最大的层作为操作层。6）症状向量构建：在操作层从核心临床语料构建三个症状向量作为类别质心。7）语义投影：因症状类别文本共病，Gram矩阵条件数≈14611接近奇异，使用Moore-Penrose伪逆解相关投影β(x)=G⁺Vc(x)，获得每症状去相关系数。8）抑郁向量：定义为三个症状向量均值质心与积极情感语料总体质心之差，保留测试集（自然语料vs HappyDB各423个）通过余弦相似度评分，以单侧Mann-Whitney U检验比较，AUC=U/(n1×n2)评估分离度。
AI.result: 1）层选择：三个原始距离度量（质心欧氏、能量、推土机）在第21层均达合格最大pseudo-F（分别为6.91、6.49、2.83），对应PERMDISP P值远高于0.05（0.43、0.65、0.47），表明分离来自质心位移而非分散度差异；其他度量最大值出现在第35-40层但分散度较弱。2）症状投影：在核心临床语料（样本内）中，各标注组在自己轴上得分最高（情绪：β_mood中位数+0.77；躯体：β_somatic中位数+1.01；自杀：β_suicidality中位数+0.96）。在自然语料（保留测试）中，排序一致保留：情绪组β_mood中位数-0.08最高（vs躯体-0.64、自杀-0.74），躯体组β_somatic中位数+0.74最高（vs情绪+0.22、自杀+0.34），自杀组β_suicidality中位数+1.40最高（vs情绪+0.85、躯体+0.91）。3）抑郁向量：核心临床vs积极情感AUC=1.000（样本内一致性检查）；自然语料vs HappyDB AUC=0.789（P=2.51×10⁻⁴⁸），即随机抽取的抑郁叙述得分高于幸福时刻描述的概率约4/5。四个语料中位余弦相似度单调递减（核心临床0.231→自然语料0.229→HappyDB 0.218→积极情感0.197），表明抑郁向量捕获渐变价态信号而非语料身份伪迹。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明Gemma-3-27B-PT在第21层残差流中抑郁症状类别几何可分，从验证临床量表构建的症状向量通过Gram-伪逆校正投影后可恢复保留测试自然语料中临床医生标注的排序，单一抑郁向量可作为价态门控区分抑郁与非抑郁文本。这些发现为从患者自然语言中提取可解释症状信号提供了机制基础，潜在应用包括：症状级别追踪、与神经生物标志物（fMRI、静息EEG、TMS诱发电位）关联、精准精神病学的症状特异性靶点。局限：将9个DSM-5症状合并为3组限制了症状特异性；仅在单一模型上验证；预处理使用另一LLM改写可能引入偏差；临床医生标注一致性≠临床效度，尚未验证诊断结果、治疗反应或纵向轨迹。伦理上需解决同意、假阳性负担和监督问题。未来方向：使用更大语料细化症状向量、跨模型族和尺度复制、将投影标定为绝对且纵向稳定的严重度量表、实证检验电生理关联和风险检测应用。

title: Import What You Need: Learning When and How to Augment EHR Graphs with External Knowledge
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026. 20 pages, 13 figures, and 18 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Longitudinal prediction from electronic health records (EHRs) is limited by the sparsity and irregularity in patient trajectories, and knowledge augmentation with external knowledge graphs (KGs) offers a promising way to alleviate these issues. However, most existing methods perform fixed, context-agnostic topology augmentation by adding the same KG nodes and edges regardless of a patient's evolving state. We propose ReTA, a Reinforcement learning-based dynamic Topology Augmentation framework that casts KG import as a per-visit, budget-aware policy. ReTA first constructs an offline refined pool of KG-grounded templates, then learns a policy to select one augment action per visit from three options: Soft Import, which enriches node features without modifying graph topology, Hard Import, which grafts a compact KG subgraph onto the visit graph to create message-passing shortcuts, and Skip, which leaves the visit unaugmented when the base encoder is already confident. To stabilize learning, ReTA employs a decoupled encoder that processes semantic and structural signals in separate channels and fuses them via adaptive gating. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV across diagnosis prediction, mortality, and readmission show that ReTA consistently outperforms strong baselines while remaining efficient, transfers across datasets and knowledge graphs, and yields interpretable augmentation patterns. The robust gains under sparse supervision highlight the advantage of ReTA's dynamic decision to import knowledge, boosting accuracy while curbing costs.

AI.tldr: ReTA提出了一种基于强化学习的动态拓扑增强框架，针对电子健康记录（EHR）纵向预测任务，将外部知识图谱（KG）的导入决策从固定、上下文无关的模式转变为逐次访问、预算感知的策略选择，在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上多项任务中显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有KG增强EHR方法存在三大局限：1）静态——对所有患者和访问施加相同的预定义KG邻域扩展，可能过度检索弱相关概念并稀释患者特异性信号；2）无预算控制——缺少对知识导入成本的约束，易导致过度增强放大噪声；3）单次性——对整个轨迹一次性增强，无法反映患者随时间演变的临床状态，限制了针对不同疾病阶段的关系建模能力。
AI.method: ReTA框架包含三步：1）离线构建精炼知识池——通过LLM对每个ICD/CCS概念蒸馏为定义+临床级联的模板，锚定到PrimeKG，并经聚类去重生成可复用模板库；2）每次访问通过强化学习策略从三种动作中选择——Soft Import（增强节点特征不改拓扑）、Hard Import（嫁接KG子图创建消息传递捷径）、Skip（基线编码器已置信时跳过增强）；3）解耦编码器分离语义通道与结构通道，通过自适应门控融合。奖励设计为增强前后同一minibatch的交叉熵差值减去Hard Import的代价惩罚。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV的诊断预测、院内死亡率、30天再入院三项任务上，ReTA一致超越包括GraphCare、RAM-EHR、KARE在内的强基线（诊断预测AUPRC最高+1.99增益），延迟更低（11.8ms vs. GraphCare 16.8ms）；跨数据集（ICD-9↔ICD-10）迁移性能优于最强基线的域内结果；UMLS替代PrimeKG后性能接近，验证框架对知识源的通用性；在稀疏监督下增益进一步扩大（罕见诊断+4.72 AUPRC）；消融实验验证了知识池、精炼策略、双模式导入各自贡献的不可替代性。
AI.conclusion: ReTA将EHR纵向预测中的知识增强重新定义为预算受限、逐次访问的决策问题，通过Soft/Hard/Skip三选项的强化学习策略实现了对患者临床状态演变的自适应响应，证明动态决策何时以及如何导入知识比固定的拓扑扩展更高效；未来工作可扩展至多模态EHR输入和不确定性感知检索。

title: Thinking effort aligns between humans and reasoning models in abductive reasoning
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. To appear in Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: A major question in cognitive modeling concerns the behavioral alignment between large language models and humans across linguistic and non-linguistic tasks. Unlike standard LLMs, large reasoning models (LRMs) are optimized with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, encouraging correct solutions to reasoning tasks rather than preference-aligned responses. Recent work (de Varda et al., 2025) investigates the cost of thinking in humans and LRMs by comparing human reaction times with model reasoning traces across a range of reasoning tasks. We isolate this alignment by turning to abductive reasoning: unlike deductive tasks, its difficulty cannot be inferred from formal structure and offers no shortcuts a model could exploit to mimic effort without genuine search, providing firmer ground for empirical claims of shared effort. We find further evidence of alignment between LRM and human reasoning effort, as well as evidence that models and humans tend to make similar errors. Finally, we show that decoding methods that let models explore multiple reasoning paths increase alignment in reasoning cost between humans and LRMs across the three models tested.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型推理模型（LRMs）与人类在溯因推理（abductive reasoning）任务中"思考努力"的对齐程度，发现模型推理token数与人类反应时显著相关，且人类和模型在哪些题目上犯错的模式也高度一致；进一步发现，采用模型厂商推荐的温度进行随机采样并多次平均，可显著增强这种对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有研究（de Varda等, 2025）显示LRM的推理token数与人类反应时在多种推理任务上相关，但该结论可能受混淆因素影响：在演绎/形式推理任务中，难度可从形式结构推断，模型可能仅通过"记住哪些形式更难"来模拟努力而无需真正搜索。本研究选择溯因推理作为更严格的检验——其证据天然欠定，难度无法从形式捷径推断，从而为"共享思考努力"的实证主张提供更坚实基础。
AI.method: （1）任务：采用AI2的ART数据集（基于ROCStories），构造迫选式溯因推理任务——呈现两个观察和一个故事的开头与结尾，要求在两个候选假设中选择最佳解释。（2）人类数据：120名英语母语Prolific被试，完成160题，记录准确率与反应时。（3）模型：测试7个LRM（R1、Qwen3-235B/32B-Thinking、GPT-OSS-20B/120B、GLM-4.5-Air、Kimi-K2）与1个非推理基线DeepSeek-V3。（4）指标：模型推理token数（log变换）与人类RT的偏相关（控制提示长度），并分析错误模式一致性。（5）解码策略：对比贪心解码（T=0）与厂商推荐的随机温度（R1 T=0.6、GPT-OSS-20B T=1、Qwen3-32B T=0.6），多次运行取平均；另测试T=2的极端温度。
AI.result: （1）贪心解码下，所有模型与人类RT的偏相关均显著，范围r=0.197（V3）至r=0.552（GPT-OSS-120B），LRM平均偏相关r=0.42，与de Varda等在三段论上的结果相当。（2）错误模式高度一致：模型共识准确率与人类逐题准确率的偏相关r=0.668；当至少75%模型答错时人类准确率仅48.7%（低于随机），而75%模型答对时人类准确率达84.6%。（3）随机解码多次平均后，对齐增强：GPT-OSS-20B从r=0.41升至r=0.55（Steiger-Williams检验p<.001），Qwen3-32B从r=0.23升至r=0.32（p<.05），R1从r=0.32升至r=0.37（不显著）。（4）T=2下对齐下降或不稳定。（5）模型规模不预测对齐强度。（6）GPT-OSS-120B解释了35%的人类RT噪声上限可解释方差。
AI.conclusion: 链式思考长度可作为认知努力的代理指标，且在溯因推理这一无法靠形式捷径模拟难度的任务上仍然成立，表明人与LRM之间存在跨系统的共享计算约束。人类与模型不仅在"思考多少"上对齐，在"哪些题难"上也对齐，削弱了"模型仅靠记忆"的解释。模型规模与对齐无关，而解码超参数是显著的实验变量：在厂商推荐的温度下随机采样并充分平均，可揭示比单一贪心解码更强的对齐，提示de Varda等（2025）的任务内对齐可能被低估。但需注意：CoT的语言表面可能并不忠实于底层计算，且观察到的行为对齐不意味着机制等价。

title: OutageDiT: A Generative Foundation Model for Power Outage Forecasting and Scenario Simulation
summary: Power-outage planning requires scenarios before an event occurs. These scenarios must represent uncertainty in magnitude, timing, and duration while preserving temporal dependence. However, severe events are rare, and data from any single region contain few examples of extreme outage and restoration patterns. To address this challenge, we introduce OutageDiT, a foundation model for generating seven-day outage trajectories at quarter-hour resolution, trained on outage and weather records across the United States. Specifically, a condition encoder processes the historical context and known future covariates once per forecast, and a shallow flow decoder reuses the resulting horizon-aligned states to generate complete trajectories. The resulting samples support point forecasting, uncertainty quantification, and conditional event simulation within one deep generative model. Across outage forecasting benchmarks, OutageDiT improves forecast accuracy and scenario quality over strong baselines and supports zero-shot transfer to held-out regions. Together, these results position conditional outage simulation as a bridge from outage forecasting to operational planning under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: OutageDiT 是一个面向电力停电预测的基础生成模型，基于扩散 Transformer (DiT) 架构并结合条件流匹配 (Conditional Flow Matching) 进行训练。它以美国全国县级停电和气象记录进行预训练，能够生成分辨率为 15 分钟、时长 7 天的停电轨迹。其核心设计包括：采用 carry-aware 数字编码解析地表示非负整数停电计数；条件编码器处理 14 天历史上下文与已知未来协变量；浅层流解码器通过复用 horizon-aligned 条件状态高效生成完整轨迹。模型支持点预测、不确定性量化以及条件事件模拟于一体，在国家级基准测试中各项指标均优于 DeepAR、TFT、CSDI、TimesFM 2.5 和 Chronos-2 等基线模型，并能在零样本条件下直接迁移到训练中未包含的密歇根州，在 INFORMS DMDA 和 IISE 挑战赛全部指标上超越最佳参赛方法。其局限性在于极端事件的预测区间覆盖率偏低。
AI.motivation: 电力公司需要在停电事件发生前进行场景规划（如人员部署、资源调度），但现有区域模型面临严重事件训练样本稀缺的难题。从全美多区域数据中学习共享模式并结合局部上下文进行条件生成，可以弥合停电预测与不确定环境下运行规划之间的差距。
AI.method: 模型架构：1) 计数表示——提出 carry-aware 反射数字编码，将停电计数（可达 10^7 量级）解析转换为 8 维实数坐标，保证相邻计数间的连续性；2) 条件编码器——采用 4 层 Transformer，将 14 天历史（336 令牌）、近期 24 小时（24 令牌）和未来 7 天已知天气/日历协变量（168 令牌）通过 RoPE 编码到共享时间轴上，并使用单次联合注意力 softmax，仅最后一次层更新未来流，输出 horizon-aligned 状态 Q；3) 流解码器——2 层 Transformer 浅层结构，从噪声状态出发通过 ODE 积分生成轨迹；条件键值在多个 ODE 步与 MC 样本间缓存复用以提升推理效率；4) 训练采用条件流匹配 (Conditional Flow Matching) 目标，外加辅助对数计数 MSE 损失。模型共 1.835 亿参数，使用 Muon + AdamW 联合优化。
AI.result: 在国家级 7 天预测基准测试中（全国分测试集，含 30 个普通窗口和 30 个事件窗口），OutageDiT 全面优于 DeepAR、TFT、CSDI、TimesFM 2.5 和 Chronos-2：在全部测试案例上 MSE 为 0.857 vs. 最佳基线 Chronos-2 的 1.041，WQL 为 0.328 vs. 0.361。消融实验表明未来条件贡献最大，去除后 MSE 升至 1.346；在场景质量评估中 OutageDiT 取得最低 Variogram Score（0.151）和最高 90% 预测区间覆盖率（0.839）。在零样本地理迁移测试（完全不含密歇根州训练数据）中，OutageDiT 在 INFORMS DMDA 平均 RMSE（164.21 vs. SARIMAX 177.24）和 IISE 挑战赛所有指标（normal RMSE、tail RMSE、nonzero F1=0.715、Winkler=2479）上均超越官方冠军方案 RSFM。极端事件的预测区间覆盖率偏低是主要限制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了面向停电轨迹的生成式基础模型能够同时提升点预测精度、概率校准与场景保真度，且可零样本迁移至地理未见区域，展示了条件停电模拟作为衔接停电预测与不确定环境下运行规划桥梁的可行性。未来工作包括将生成场景集成至抢修队部署与资源分配决策、考虑天气预报误差以及在分布偏移下扩展至最坏情况规划。

title: Accurate in space, unreliable in time: how LLMs represent national cultural change
comment: 38 pages, 12 figures, 36 tables; includes Supplementary Materials
summary: Assessments of cultural alignment have become an important part of the development and improvement of large language models (LLMs). However, the majority of the evaluations treat culture as a single snapshot, investigating only whether a model represents a society accurately at the current time. Research in cultural psychology shows that cultural values change at different rates and directions over time. Therefore, a "culturally aware" model should capture not only where a culture is today but also how it has changed over time. We examine this missing dimension of cultural awareness using more than two decades of the World Values Survey data. We compare the cultural trajectories of 40 countries with the trajectories produced by four state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs on the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map. Our findings show that while models generally place countries close to their most recent surveyed positions, these representations tend to lag several years behind that position. They also capture only part of the magnitude of the observed change, introduce movement where little occurred, and rarely reproduce reversals in countries' trajectories. These findings point to temporal flattening and suggest that snapshot accuracy can give an incomplete picture of cultural awareness in LLMs and have implications for model evaluation, representational harms, and the governance of culturally aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了四个SOTA大语言模型（Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.6 Flash、Qwen3.6-Plus）能否捕捉40个国家在Inglehart-Welzel文化图谱上20余年的价值观变化轨迹，发现模型虽然在"快照对齐"（当前定位）上表现尚可，但在"变化对齐"（随时间的演变轨迹）上存在严重缺陷，表现为时间滞后、变化幅度低估、为低变化国家虚构变动以及无法再现真正的方向逆转，即"时间扁平化"问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM文化对齐评估普遍采用单一时间快照视角，将文化视为静态属性，而文化心理学明确指出文化价值会随时间以不同速率、不同方向变化并可能发生逆转。因此，一个真正"文化感知"的模型不仅要准确刻画文化的当下位置，还需再现其历史轨迹。这一时间维度长期被忽视，可能导致LLM文化评估产生不完整甚至误导性的结论。
AI.method: 研究采用世界价值观调查（WVS）第四至第七波（约1999–2023年）40个国家的实证数据作为基准，使用10项核心WVS指标在Inglehart-Welzel文化地图两维度（传统-世俗理性、生存-自我表达）上计算坐标。设计三种提示条件：C0（不指定国家/年份）、C1（仅指定国家）、C2（指定国家与调查年份）。要求模型输出概率分布形式的"语言化分布"（verbalized distribution），每条件重复k=10次取均值。通过几何指标（净位移、步长、转角、直线度）刻画轨迹，并采用自举法（bootstrap）评估不确定性。通过排列检验（permutation null）衡量模型是否捕捉到"何时"发生变化（而非仅"方向"）。将40国分为四类轨迹：逆转型（6国）、方向型（10国）、低变化/稳定型（4国）和模糊型（20国）。
AI.result: 快照对齐方面：四模型将各国放置于距其最新调查位置0.153–0.238标准化单位处（全球重心平均距0.40），准确度尚可但国别差异大，东亚/东南亚国家（泰国、台湾、韩国、日本）误差最大。在变化对齐方面：（1）隐含时间锚点滞后：未指定年份时，模型的"无提示表征"最接近某国最近调查之前的某次调查，平均滞后4.5–7.0年，Claude滞后最久。（2）方向大致对但量级不足：10个方向型国家的中位幅度比仅0.45–0.68。（3）虚构运动：对调查变化极小的四国，模型反而"移动"了0.113–0.170单位，超出真实变化。（4）时序信号弱：排列检验显示，仅Gemini在所有规格下显著捕捉到变化发生的"时间点"，Claude勉强显著，GPT和Qwen无时序判别力。（5）逆转再现能力差：6个逆转型国家真实转角129°–169°，仅4例（涉及日本、约旦、印尼）满足"急转+足够位移"标准，Qwen从未急转。（6）显式标注年份几乎无额外帮助（C1 vs C2差距约0.001–0.009）。研究发现LLM表征呈现"时间扁平化"：空间准确，时间不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论：当前SOTA大语言模型本质上是将文化表征为"位置"而非"轨迹"，其在空间上的准确性可能掩盖时间维度的根本缺陷。这一"时间扁平化"问题对使用LLM作为人类代理（包括社会科学"硅样本"）的实践构成新的误差来源，并可能助长将特定历史时点的价值观本质化为社会群体固有特征的心理本质主义，产生表征性伤害。研究呼吁文化对齐评估必须从单一快照扩展到轨迹分析，LLM开发与治理也需纳入时间维度的考量。局限性包括：仅依赖Inglehart-Welzel两维度、未涵盖道德/政治/性别等更广泛文化范畴、WVS为非连续测量、模型可能存储但无法通过简单提示调取时间信息。

title: Sparse Readout Prism: Explaining Logit-Lens Scores in Features Instead of Tokens
comment: 55 pages, 33 figures, 42 tables. Under review. Code: this https URL Dictionaries: this https URL
summary: A language model's prediction of its next token develops across layers, and lens methods track this process by decoding intermediate hidden states into tokens. But a lens reading reflects both the hidden state and the readout (the unembedding matrix) used to decode it. Many lenses are fit on a corpus, and we show that two lenses differing only in their fitting corpus can report different tokens for the same hidden states. We call this dependence corpus conditionality. To examine readout structure independently of the fitting corpus, we introduce Sparse Readout Prism (SRP), which decomposes the readout using only its weights and expresses any token logit or logit difference as a sum of contributions from sparse readout features. This reveals readout features as a new unit of analysis for lens readings, exposing structure that token identities can obscure and enabling comparisons across tokens, contexts, layers, and lenses. Replacing the original readout with SRP's sparse approximation reconstructs 8.9-17.3 percentage points more of the tested logit differences than the strongest of six baselines built on geometric relations among readout rows. Ablating features shifts logit differences in proportion to their SRP contributions. Although token readings vary with the fitting corpus, the dominant readout feature remains stable. Because SRP uses no corpus in its construction, it provides a control independent of the fitting corpus for lens analyses.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Sparse Readout Prism（SRP）：在语言模型输出端（unembedding/LM head）的权重行上学习一个共享、过完备且稀疏的字典，把任一 token logit、logit 差或对比分数精确分解为若干“读出特征”的有符号贡献与残差。SRP 不改变原 lens 对隐藏状态的变换，只替换其报告单位，从而在跨 token、上下文、层和 lens 时使用固定坐标系。实验显示，它相对六种仅基于行几何的基线，在测试 logit 差上的覆盖率提高 8.9–17.3 个百分点；消融特征时，实际 logit 差变化与预测贡献高度相关。论文还揭示 fitted lens 的 corpus conditionality：相同隐藏状态经不同语料拟合的 lens 可能报告不同表面语言，但同一读出特征通常仍占主导。
AI.motivation: 传统 lens 方法把中间隐藏状态解码为 token，并常将排名直接解释为中间计算的语言或语义状态。然而，观测结果同时由隐藏状态和输出读出矩阵决定；一个 token 行可能混合多个语义/结构方向，不同 token 或不同表面形式又可能共享同一方向。对 fitted lens 而言，输出还受训练语料影响。因此，单看 token 排名无法区分状态变化、读出结构变化与解码仪器变化。
AI.method: 方法：1）在 unembedding 矩阵 W_U 的行上训练 TopK 稀疏自编码器，获得共享偏移、读出特征方向 d_i 和每行的稀疏系数 z_{v,i}；将 W_U 重建为 μ+Σz_{v,i}d_i+r_v。2）对任意选定的读出方向 q_α=Σα_v w_v，将状态经任意 lens 解码为 \tilde h_ℓ，再把分数 \tilde h_ℓ^T q_α 分解为特征贡献 c_i=β_i(α)(\tilde h_ℓ^T d_i)、偏移项和残差，其中 β_i=Σα_v z_{v,i}；对零和对比，偏移项抵消。3）以 Top-1 保持、KL、重建覆盖率、残余误差和符号一致性评估；覆盖率要求重建符号正确且 |残差|/|精确分数|<0.5。4）通过消融读出方向、跨语言 fitted lens 语料替换及多种基线验证分解忠实性和因果预测性。
AI.result: 主要结果：SRP 在六种无 softcap 的读出头上，相比最强行几何基线，将所测 logit 差的覆盖率提高 8.9–17.3 个百分点；替换读出头后 Qwen/Ministral 的 top-1 保持率约 0.89–0.90，推理蒸馏模型约 0.75–0.76。消融特征的预测—实测变化 r² 为 0.83–0.93，随机方向对照不高于 0.06，表明贡献大小和方向具有局部预测力。跨不同随机种子的字典虽方向不一一对应，但对比解释结构明显高于随机对照，说明语义分组具有一定稳定性。固定同一隐藏状态、仅改变 fitted lens 的拟合语料时，英中任务中 39/80 个提示报告不同文字系统，特征主导一致性仍达 77/80；英德实验为 84/90。更换到另一种 ridge/tuned-lens 风格翻译器后为 67/80。增大拟合语料并未一致消除 token 表面语言分歧，但主导特征基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: SRP 将 lens 分析单位从离散 token 改为可跨层、上下文和 lens 比较的稀疏读出特征，并保持严格的局部加性解释。论文的证据支持两项结论：SRP 分解在重建、干预预测和跨 seed 结构恢复上忠实有效；fitted lens 的 token 排名具有语料依赖性，因此不能单独作为潜在表示语言或语义的直接证据。SRP 可作为固定在模型权重中的参考坐标，分离状态变化与读出/仪器变化。需要注意，SRP 只解释选定读出分数和输出空间结构；电路层面的必要性、充分性及生成行为仍需独立的激活侧干预。

title: On-Policy Distillation Meets Off-Policy GRPO: Training Compact Instruction-Following Rerankers
summary: Compact instruction-following rerankers are attractive for deployment, but conventional distillation pipelines typically train students by offline imitation of teacher outputs on a fixed set of examples, constraining supervision to the teacher's observed ranking space. We revisit reranker distillation through the lens of reinforcement learning. We propose a two-stage framework combining off-policy teacher optimization with on-policy student distillation. In Stage 1, a 4B teacher reranker is strengthened with off-policy GRPO using LLM-judge feedback on 88K instruction-following examples. In Stage 2, a compact 1B student samples rankings from its own policy and receives soft teacher-derived rewards on those rankings, coupling student exploration with knowledge transfer. Our strongest gains appear under distribution shift. On MAIR-11, the original 11-subset, 869-query evaluation, the proposed student reaches 0.7670 nDCG@6, outperforming offline listwise KD by +4.6 points. Controlled comparisons against offline pairwise RankNet KD and on-policy GKD show that neither changing the offline distillation objective nor moving teacher-distribution matching on-policy reproduces the performance of reward-based on-policy distillation over student-sampled rankings. The advantage persists on MAIR-Full: across all 126 tasks and 9,356 queries, the proposed method obtains the highest task-macro point estimates among the evaluated distillation variants, reaching 0.6808 nDCG@6 and 0.7865 MRR@6.
